text: and with difficulty coasting along it we came unto a certain place called Fair Havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

title: Acts 27:9
text: And when much time was spent, and the voyage was now dangerous, because the Fast was now already gone by, Paul admonished them,

title: Acts 27:10
text: and said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the lading and the ship, but also of our lives.

title: Acts 27:11
text: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship, than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

title: Acts 27:12
text: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to put to sea from thence, if by any means they could reach Phoenix, and winter [there; which is] a haven of Crete, looking northeast and south-east.

title: Acts 27:13
text: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close in shore.

title: Acts 27:14
text: But after no long time there beat down from it a tempestuous wind, which is called Euraquilo:

title: Acts 27:15
text: and when the ship was caught, and could not face the wind, we gave way [to it,] and were driven.

title: Acts 27:16
text: And running under the lee of a small island called Cauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat:

title: Acts 27:17
text: and when they had hoisted it up, they used helps, under-girding the ship; and, fearing lest they should be cast upon the Syrtis, they lowered the gear, and so were driven.

title: Acts 27:18
text: And as we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw the [the freight] overboard;

title: Acts 27:19
text: and the third day they cast out with their own hands the tackling of the ship.

title: Acts 27:20
text: And when neither sun nor stars shone upon [us] for many days, and no small tempest lay on [us,] all hope that we should be saved was now taken away.

title: Acts 27:21
text: And when they had been long without food, then Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have set sail from Crete, and have gotten this injury and loss.

title: Acts 27:22
text: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer; for there shall be no loss of life among you, but [only] of the ship.

title: Acts 27:23
text: For there stood by me this night an angel of the God whose I am, whom also I serve,

title: Acts 27:24
text: saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must stand before Caesar: and lo, God hath granted thee all them that sail with thee.

title: Acts 27:25
text: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even so as it hath been spoken unto me.

title: Acts 27:26
text: But we must be cast upon a certain island.

title: Acts 27:27
text: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven to and fro in the [sea of] Adria, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some country:

title: Acts 27:28
text: and they sounded, and found twenty fathoms; and after a little space, they sounded again, and found fifteen fathoms.

title: Acts 27:29
text: And fearing lest haply we should be cast ashore on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for the day.

title: Acts 27:30
text: And as the sailors were seeking to flee out of the ship, and had lowered the boat into the sea, under color as though they would lay out anchors from the foreship,

title: Acts 27:31
text: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

title: Acts 27:32
text: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.

title: Acts 27:33
text: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take some food, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

title: Acts 27:34
text: Wherefore I beseech you to take some food: for this is for your safety: for there shall not a hair perish from the head of any of you.

title: Acts 27:35
text: And when he had said this, and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; and he brake it, and began to eat.

title: Acts 27:36
text: Then were they all of good cheer, and themselves also took food.

title: Acts 27:37
text: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

title: Acts 27:38
text: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

title: Acts 27:39
text: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they perceived a certain bay with a beach, and they took counsel whether they could drive the ship upon it.

title: Acts 27:40
text: And casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time loosing the bands of the rudders; and hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

title: Acts 27:41
text: But lighting upon a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground; and the foreship struck and remained unmoveable, but the stern began to break up by the violence [of the waves].

title: Acts 27:42
text: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any [of them] should swim out, and escape.

title: Acts 27:43
text: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stayed them from their purpose; and commanded that they who could swim should cast themselves overboard, and get first to the land;

title: Acts 27:44
text: and the rest, some on planks, and some on [other] things from the ship. And so it came to pass, that they all escaped safe to the land.

title: Acts 28:1
text: And when we were escaped, then we knew that the island was called Melita.

title: Acts 28:2
text: And the barbarians showed us no common kindness; for they kindled a fire, and received us all, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

title: Acts 28:3
text: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out by reason of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

title: Acts 28:4
text: And when the barbarians saw the [venomous] creature hanging from his hand, they said one to another, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped from the sea, yet Justice hath not suffered to live.

title: Acts 28:5
text: Howbeit he shook off the creature into the fire, and took no harm.

title: Acts 28:6
text: But they expected that he would have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but when they were long in expectation and beheld nothing amiss came to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

title: Acts 28:7
text: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us, and entertained us three days courteously.

title: Acts 28:8
text: And it was so, that the father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery: unto whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laying his hands on him healed him.

title: Acts 28:9
text: And when this was done, the rest also that had diseases in the island came, and were cured:

title: Acts 28:10
text: who also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board such things as we needed.

title: Acts 28:11
text: And after three months we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was The Twin Brothers.

title: Acts 28:12
text: And touching at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

title: Acts 28:13
text: And from thence we made a circuit, and arrived at Rhegium: and after one day a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli;

title: Acts 28:14
text: where we found brethren, and were entreated to tarry with them seven days: and so we came to Rome.

title: Acts 28:15
text: And from thence the brethren, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns; whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

title: Acts 28:16
text: And when we entered into Rome, Paul was suffered to abide by himself with the soldier that guarded him.

title: Acts 28:17
text: And it came to pass, that after three days he called together those that were the chief of the Jews: and when they were come together, he said unto them, I, brethren, though I had done nothing against the people, or the customs of our fathers, yet was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans:

title: Acts 28:18
text: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me at liberty, because there was no cause of death in me.

title: Acts 28:19
text: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had aught whereof to accuse my nation.

title: Acts 28:20
text: For this cause therefore did I entreat you to see and to speak with [me]: for because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

title: Acts 28:21
text: And they said unto him, We neither received letters from Judaea concerning thee, nor did any of the brethren come hither and report or speak any harm of thee.

title: Acts 28:22
text: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.

title: Acts 28:23
text: And when they had appointed him a day, they came to him into his lodging in great number; to whom he expounded [the matter,] testifying the kingdom of God, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning till evening.

title: Acts 28:24
text: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

title: Acts 28:25
text: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Spirit through Isaiah the prophet unto your fathers,

title: Acts 28:26
text: saying, Go thou unto this people, and say, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall in no wise understand; And seeing ye shall see, and shall in no wise perceive:

title: Acts 28:27
text: For this people's heart is waxed gross, And their ears are dull of hearing, And their eyes they have closed; Lest, haply they should perceive with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And should turn again, And I should heal them.

title: Acts 28:28
text: Be it known therefore unto you, that this salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles: they will also hear.

title: Acts 28:29
text: [And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, having much disputing among themselves.]

title: Acts 28:30
text: And he abode two whole years in his own hired dwelling, and received all that went in unto him,

title: Acts 28:31
text: preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, none forbidding him.

title: Romans 1:1
text: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called [to be] an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

title: Romans 1:2
text: which he promised afore through his prophets in the holy scriptures,

title: Romans 1:3
text: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,

title: Romans 1:4
text: who was declared [to be] the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead; [even] Jesus Christ our Lord,

title: Romans 1:5
text: through whom we received grace and apostleship, unto obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name's sake;

title: Romans 1:6
text: among whom are ye also called [to be] Jesus Christ's:

title: Romans 1:7
text: To all that are in Rome, beloved of God, called [to be] saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 1:8
text: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

title: Romans 1:9
text: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the gospel of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you, always in my prayers

title: Romans 1:10
text: making request, if by any means now at length I may be prospered by the will of God to come unto you.

title: Romans 1:11
text: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

title: Romans 1:12
text: that is, that I with you may be comforted in you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.

title: Romans 1:13
text: And I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you (and was hindered hitherto), that I might have some fruit in you also, even as in the rest of the Gentiles.

title: Romans 1:14
text: I am debtor both to Greeks and to Barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.

title: Romans 1:15
text: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you also that are in Rome.

title: Romans 1:16
text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

title: Romans 1:17
text: For therein is revealed a righteousness of God from faith unto faith: as it is written, But the righteous shall live by faith.

title: Romans 1:18
text: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hinder the truth in unrighteousness;

title: Romans 1:19
text: because that which is known of God is manifest in them; for God manifested it unto them.

title: Romans 1:20
text: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, [even] his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse:

title: Romans 1:21
text: because that, knowing God, they glorified him not as God, neither gave thanks; but became vain in their reasonings, and their senseless heart was darkened.

title: Romans 1:22
text: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

title: Romans 1:23
text: and changed the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.

title: Romans 1:24
text: Wherefore God gave them up in the lusts of their hearts unto uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves:

title: Romans 1:25
text: for that they exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshipped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

title: Romans 1:26
text: For this cause God gave them up unto vile passions: for their women changed the natural use into that which is against nature:

title: Romans 1:27
text: and likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another, men with men working unseemliness, and receiving in themselves that recompense of their error which was due.

title: Romans 1:28
text: And even as they refused to have God in [their] knowledge, God gave them up unto a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

title: Romans 1:29
text: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

title: Romans 1:30
text: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

title: Romans 1:31
text: without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unmerciful:

title: Romans 1:32
text: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that they that practise such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also consent with them that practise them.

title: Romans 2:1
text: Wherefore thou art without excuse, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judges another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest dost practise the same things.

title: Romans 2:2
text: And we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against them that practise such things.

title: Romans 2:3
text: And reckonest thou this, O man, who judgest them that practise such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

title: Romans 2:4
text: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

title: Romans 2:5
text: but after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up for thyself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

title: Romans 2:6
text: who will render to every man according to his works:

title: Romans 2:7
text: to them that by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and incorruption, eternal life:

title: Romans 2:8
text: but unto them that are factious, and obey not the truth, but obey unrighteousness, [shall be] wrath and indignation,

title: Romans 2:9
text: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that worketh evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Greek;

title: Romans 2:10
text: but glory and honor and peace to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek:

title: Romans 2:11
text: for there is no respect of persons with God.

title: Romans 2:12
text: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;

title: Romans 2:13
text: for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified:

title: Romans 2:14
text: (for when Gentiles that have not the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are the law unto themselves;

title: Romans 2:15
text: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness therewith, and their thoughts one with another accusing or else excusing [them]);

title: Romans 2:16
text: in the day when God shall judge the secrets of men, according to my gospel, by Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 2:17
text: But if thou bearest the name of a Jew, and restest upon the law, and gloriest in God,

title: Romans 2:18
text: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

title: Romans 2:19
text: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them that are in darkness,

title: Romans 2:20
text: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth;

title: Romans 2:21
text: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

title: Romans 2:22
text: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?

title: Romans 2:23
text: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou God?

title: Romans 2:24
text: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you, even as it is written.

title: Romans 2:25
text: For circumcision indeed profiteth, if thou be a doer of the law: but if thou be a transgressor of the law, thy circumcision is become uncircumcision.

title: Romans 2:26
text: If therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?

title: Romans 2:27
text: and shall not the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who with the letter and circumcision art a transgressor of the law?

title: Romans 2:28
text: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh:

title: Romans 2:29
text: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

title: Romans 3:1
text: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?

title: Romans 3:2
text: Much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of God.

title: Romans 3:3
text: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?

title: Romans 3:4
text: God forbid: yea, let God be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy words, And mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.

title: Romans 3:5
text: But if our righteousness commendeth the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? (I speak after the manner of men.)

title: Romans 3:6
text: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

title: Romans 3:7
text: But if the truth of God through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

title: Romans 3:8
text: and why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.

title: Romans 3:9
text: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;

title: Romans 3:10
text: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one;

title: Romans 3:11
text: There is none that understandeth, There is none that seeketh after God;

title: Romans 3:12
text: They have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not, so much as one:

title: Romans 3:13
text: Their throat is an open sepulchre; With their tongues they have used deceit: The poison of asps is under their lips:

title: Romans 3:14
text: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

title: Romans 3:15
text: Their feet are swift to shed blood;

title: Romans 3:16
text: Destruction and misery are in their ways;

title: Romans 3:17
text: And the way of peace have they not known:

title: Romans 3:18
text: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

title: Romans 3:19
text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God:

title: Romans 3:20
text: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law [cometh] the knowledge of sin.

title: Romans 3:21
text: But now apart from the law a righteousness of God hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

title: Romans 3:22
text: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;

title: Romans 3:23
text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

title: Romans 3:24
text: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

title: Romans 3:25
text: whom God set forth [to be] a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of God;

title: Romans 3:26
text: for the showing, [I say], of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in Jesus.

title: Romans 3:27
text: Where then is the glorying? It is excluded. By what manner of law? of works? Nay: but by a law of faith.

title: Romans 3:28
text: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

title: Romans 3:29
text: Or is God [the God] of Jews only? is he not [the God] of Gentiles also? Yea, of Gentiles also:

title: Romans 3:30
text: if so be that God is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.

title: Romans 3:31
text: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.

title: Romans 4:1
text: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather, hath found according to the flesh?

title: Romans 4:2
text: For if Abraham was justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not toward God.

title: Romans 4:3
text: For what saith the scripture? And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.

title: Romans 4:4
text: Now to him that worketh, the reward is not reckoned as of grace, but as of debt.

title: Romans 4:5
text: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.

title: Romans 4:6
text: Even as David also pronounceth blessing upon the man, unto whom God reckoneth righteousness apart from works,

title: Romans 4:7
text: [saying], Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, And whose sins are covered.

title: Romans 4:8
text: Blessed is the man to whom, the Lord will not reckon sin.

title: Romans 4:9
text: Is this blessing then pronounced upon the circumcision, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say, To Abraham his faith was reckoned for righteousness.

title: Romans 4:10
text: How then was it reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision:

title: Romans 4:11
text: and he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision; that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might be reckoned unto them;

title: Romans 4:12
text: and the father of circumcision to them who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham which he had in uncircumcision.

title: Romans 4:13
text: For not through the law was the promise to Abraham or to his seed that he should be heir of the world, but through the righteousness of faith.

title: Romans 4:14
text: For if they that are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of none effect:

title: Romans 4:15
text: for the law worketh wrath; but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.

title: Romans 4:16
text: For this cause [it is] of faith, that [it may be] according to grace; to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all

title: Romans 4:17
text: (as it is written, A father of many nations have I made thee) before him whom he believed, [even] God, who giveth life to the dead, and calleth the things that are not, as though they were.

title: Romans 4:18
text: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, So shall thy seed be.

title: Romans 4:19
text: And without being weakened in faith he considered his own body now as good as dead (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah's womb;

title: Romans 4:20
text: yet, looking unto the promise of God, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to God,

title: Romans 4:21
text: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

title: Romans 4:22
text: Wherefore also it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.

title: Romans 4:23
text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned unto him;

title: Romans 4:24
text: but for our sake also, unto whom it shall be reckoned, who believe on him that raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

title: Romans 4:25
text: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

title: Romans 5:1
text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: Romans 5:2
text: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

title: Romans 5:3
text: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;

title: Romans 5:4
text: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:

title: Romans 5:5
text: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.

title: Romans 5:6
text: For while we were yet weak, in due season Christ died for the ungodly.

title: Romans 5:7
text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.

title: Romans 5:8
text: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

title: Romans 5:9
text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath [of God] through him.

title: Romans 5:10
text: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;

title: Romans 5:11
text: and not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

title: Romans 5:12
text: Therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned:--

title: Romans 5:13
text: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

title: Romans 5:14
text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of Adam's transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.

title: Romans 5:15
text: But not as the trespass, so also [is] the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound unto the many.

title: Romans 5:16
text: And not as through one that sinned, [so] is the gift: for the judgment [came] of one unto condemnation, but the free gift [came] of many trespasses unto justification.

title: Romans 5:17
text: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, [even] Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 5:18
text: So then as through one trespass [the judgment came] unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness [the free gift came] unto all men to justification of life.

title: Romans 5:19
text: For as through the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.

title: Romans 5:20
text: And the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:

title: Romans 5:21
text: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: Romans 6:1
text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

title: Romans 6:2
text: God forbid. We who died to sin, how shall we any longer live therein?

title: Romans 6:3
text: Or are ye ignorant that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

title: Romans 6:4
text: We were buried therefore with him through baptism unto death: that like as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

title: Romans 6:5
text: For if we have become united with [him] in the likeness of his death, we shall be also [in the likeness] of his resurrection;

title: Romans 6:6
text: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with [him], that the body of sin might be done away, that so we should no longer be in bondage to sin;

title: Romans 6:7
text: for he that hath died is justified from sin.

title: Romans 6:8
text: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him;

title: Romans 6:9
text: knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death no more hath dominion over him.

title: Romans 6:10
text: For the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

title: Romans 6:11
text: Even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus.

title: Romans 6:12
text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey the lusts thereof:

title: Romans 6:13
text: neither present your members unto sin [as] instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves unto God, as alive from the dead, and your members [as] instruments of righteousness unto God.

title: Romans 6:14
text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under law, but under grace.

title: Romans 6:15
text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? God forbid.

title: Romans 6:16
text: Know ye not, that to whom ye present yourselves [as] servants unto obedience, his servants ye are whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

title: Romans 6:17
text: But thanks be to God, that, whereas ye were servants of sin, ye became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto ye were delivered;

title: Romans 6:18
text: and being made free from sin, ye became servants of righteousness.

title: Romans 6:19
text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye presented your members [as] servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now present your members [as] servants to righteousness unto sanctification.

title: Romans 6:20
text: For when ye were servants of sin, ye were free in regard of righteousness.

title: Romans 6:21
text: What fruit then had ye at that time in the things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

title: Romans 6:22
text: But now being made free from sin and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end eternal life.

title: Romans 6:23
text: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: Romans 7:1
text: Or are ye ignorant, brethren (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law hath dominion over a man for so long time as he liveth?

title: Romans 7:2
text: For the woman that hath a husband is bound by law to the husband while he liveth; but if the husband die, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

title: Romans 7:3
text: So then if, while the husband liveth, she be joined to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if the husband die, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she be joined to another man.

title: Romans 7:4
text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ; that ye should be joined to another, [even] to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit unto God.

title: Romans 7:5
text: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were through the law, wrought in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

title: Romans 7:6
text: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that wherein we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

title: Romans 7:7
text: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Howbeit, I had not known sin, except through the law: for I had not known coveting, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet:

title: Romans 7:8
text: but sin, finding occasion, wrought in me through the commandment all manner of coveting: for apart from the law sin [is] dead.

title: Romans 7:9
text: And I was alive apart from the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died;

title: Romans 7:10
text: and the commandment, which [was] unto life, this I found [to be] unto death:

title: Romans 7:11
text: for sin, finding occasion, through the commandment beguiled me, and through it slew me.

title: Romans 7:12
text: So that the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

title: Romans 7:13
text: Did then that which is good become death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; --that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.

title: Romans 7:14
text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

title: Romans 7:15
text: For that which I do I know not: for not what I would, that do I practise; but what I hate, that I do.

title: Romans 7:16
text: But if what I would not, that I do, I consent unto the law that it is good.

title: Romans 7:17
text: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.

title: Romans 7:18
text: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me, but to do that which is good [is] not.

title: Romans 7:19
text: For the good which I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I practise.

title: Romans 7:20
text: But if what I would not, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.

title: Romans 7:21
text: I find then the law, that, to me who would do good, evil is present.

title: Romans 7:22
text: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

title: Romans 7:23
text: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

title: Romans 7:24
text: Wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me out of the body of this death?

title: Romans 7:25
text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then I of myself with the mind, indeed, serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

title: Romans 8:1
text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them that are in Christ Jesus.

title: Romans 8:2
text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

title: Romans 8:3
text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

title: Romans 8:4
text: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

title: Romans 8:5
text: For they that are after the flesh mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

title: Romans 8:6
text: For the mind of the flesh is death; but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:

title: Romans 8:7
text: because the mind of the flesh is enmity against God; for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can it be:

title: Romans 8:8
text: and they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

title: Romans 8:9
text: But ye are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you. But if any man hath not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

title: Romans 8:10
text: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the spirit is life because of righteousness.

title: Romans 8:11
text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwelleth in you, he that raised up Christ Jesus from the dead shall give life also to your mortal bodies through his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

title: Romans 8:12
text: So then, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh:

title: Romans 8:13
text: for if ye live after the flesh, ye must die; but if by the Spirit ye put to death the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

title: Romans 8:14
text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.

title: Romans 8:15
text: For ye received not the spirit of bondage again unto fear; but ye received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

title: Romans 8:16
text: The Spirit himself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are children of God:

title: Romans 8:17
text: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with [him], that we may be also glorified with [him].

title: Romans 8:18
text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed to us-ward.

title: Romans 8:19
text: For the earnest expectation of the creation waiteth for the revealing of the sons of God.

title: Romans 8:20
text: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but by reason of him who subjected it, in hope

title: Romans 8:21
text: that the creation itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

title: Romans 8:22
text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

title: Romans 8:23
text: And not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first-fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for [our] adoption, [to wit], the redemption of our body.

title: Romans 8:24
text: For in hope were we saved: but hope that is seen is not hope: for who hopeth for that which he seeth?

title: Romans 8:25
text: But if we hope for that which we see not, [then] do we with patience wait for it.

title: Romans 8:26
text: And in like manner the Spirit also helpeth our infirmity: for we know not how to pray as we ought; but the Spirit himself maketh intercession for [us] with groanings which cannot be uttered;

title: Romans 8:27
text: and he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to [the will of] God.

title: Romans 8:28
text: And we know that to them that love God all things work together for good, [even] to them that are called according to [his] purpose.

title: Romans 8:29
text: For whom he foreknew, he also foreordained [to be] conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren:

title: Romans 8:30
text: and whom he foreordained, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

title: Romans 8:31
text: What then shall we say to these things? If God [is] for us, who [is] against us?

title: Romans 8:32
text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not also with him freely give us all things?

title: Romans 8:33
text: Who shall lay anything to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth;

title: Romans 8:34
text: who is he that condemneth? It is Christ Jesus that died, yea rather, that was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

title: Romans 8:35
text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

title: Romans 8:36
text: Even as it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

title: Romans 8:37
text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

title: Romans 8:38
text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

title: Romans 8:39
text: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: Romans 9:1
text: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience bearing witness with me in the Holy Spirit,

title: Romans 9:2
text: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

title: Romans 9:3
text: For I could wish that I myself were anathema from Christ for my brethren's sake, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

title: Romans 9:4
text: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service [of God], and the promises;

title: Romans 9:5
text: whose are the fathers, and of whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

title: Romans 9:6
text: But [it is] not as though the word of God hath come to nought. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel:

title: Romans 9:7
text: neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

title: Romans 9:8
text: That is, it is not the children of the flesh that are children of God; but the children of the promise are reckoned for a seed.

title: Romans 9:9
text: For this is a word of promise, According to this season will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.

title: Romans 9:10
text: And not only so; but Rebecca also having conceived by one, [even] by our father Isaac--

title: Romans 9:11
text: for [the children] being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth,

title: Romans 9:12
text: it was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

title: Romans 9:13
text: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.

title: Romans 9:14
text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

title: Romans 9:15
text: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.

title: Romans 9:16
text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that hath mercy.

title: Romans 9:17
text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, For this very purpose did I raise thee up, that I might show in thee my power, and that my name might be published abroad in all the earth.

title: Romans 9:18
text: So then he hath mercy on whom he will, and whom he will be hardeneth.

title: Romans 9:19
text: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he still find fault? For who withstandeth his will?

title: Romans 9:20
text: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why didst thou make me thus?

title: Romans 9:21
text: Or hath not the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel unto honor, and another unto dishonor?

title: Romans 9:22
text: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering vessels of wrath fitted unto destruction:

title: Romans 9:23
text: and that he might make known the riches of his glory upon vessels of mercy, which he afore prepared unto glory,

title: Romans 9:24
text: [even] us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

title: Romans 9:25
text: As he saith also in Hosea, I will call that my people, which was not my people; And her beloved, that was not beloved.

title: Romans 9:26
text: And it shall be, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, There shall they be called sons of the living God.

title: Romans 9:27
text: And Isaiah crieth concerning Israel, If the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant that shall be saved:

title: Romans 9:28
text: for the Lord will execute [his] word upon the earth, finishing it and cutting it short.

title: Romans 9:29
text: And, as Isaiah hath said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, We had become as Sodom, and had been made like unto Gomorrah.

title: Romans 9:30
text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who followed not after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:

title: Romans 9:31
text: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, did not arrive at [that] law.

title: Romans 9:32
text: Wherefore? Because [they sought it] not by faith, but as it were by works. They stumbled at the stone of stumbling;

title: Romans 9:33
text: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.

title: Romans 10:1
text: Brethren, my heart's desire and my supplication to God is for them, that they may be saved.

title: Romans 10:2
text: For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

title: Romans 10:3
text: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own, they did not subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

title: Romans 10:4
text: For Christ is the end of the law unto righteousness to every one that believeth.

title: Romans 10:5
text: For Moses writeth that the man that doeth the righteousness which is of the law shall live thereby.

title: Romans 10:6
text: But the righteousness which is of faith saith thus, Say not in thy heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down:)

title: Romans 10:7
text: or, Who shall descend into the abyss? (That is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)

title: Romans 10:8
text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

title: Romans 10:9
text: because if thou shalt confess with thy mouth Jesus [as] Lord, and shalt believe in thy heart that God raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved:

title: Romans 10:10
text: for with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

title: Romans 10:11
text: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be put to shame.

title: Romans 10:12
text: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek: for the same [Lord] is Lord of all, and is rich unto all that call upon him:

title: Romans 10:13
text: for, Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

title: Romans 10:14
text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

title: Romans 10:15
text: and how shall they preach, except they be sent? even as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that bring glad tidings of good things!

title: Romans 10:16
text: But they did not all hearken to the glad tidings. For Isaiah saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

title: Romans 10:17
text: So belief [cometh] of hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

title: Romans 10:18
text: But I say, Did they not hear? Yea, verily, Their sound went out into all the earth, And their words unto the ends of the world.

title: Romans 10:19
text: But I say, Did Israel not know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, With a nation void of understanding will I anger you.

title: Romans 10:20
text: And Isaiah is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I became manifest unto them that asked not of me.

title: Romans 10:21
text: But as to Israel he saith, All the day long did I spread out my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

title: Romans 11:1
text: I say then, Did God cast off his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

title: Romans 11:2
text: God did not cast off his people which he foreknew. Or know ye not what the scripture saith of Elijah? how he pleadeth with God against Israel:

title: Romans 11:3
text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, they have digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

title: Romans 11:4
text: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have left for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.

title: Romans 11:5
text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

title: Romans 11:6
text: But if it is by grace, it is no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace.

title: Romans 11:7
text: What then? that which Israel seeketh for, that he obtained not; but the election obtained it, and the rest were hardened:

title: Romans 11:8
text: according as it is written, God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, unto this very day.

title: Romans 11:9
text: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, And a stumblingblock, and a recompense unto them:

title: Romans 11:10
text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, And bow thou down their back always.

title: Romans 11:11
text: I say then, Did they stumble that they might fall? God forbid: but by their fall salvation [is come] unto the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

title: Romans 11:12
text: Now if their fall, is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

title: Romans 11:13
text: But I speak to you that are Gentiles. Inasmuch then as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

title: Romans 11:14
text: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy [them that are] my flesh, and may save some of them.

title: Romans 11:15
text: For if the casting away of them [is] the reconciling of the world, what [shall] the receiving [of them be], but life from the dead?

title: Romans 11:16
text: And if the firstfruit is holy, so is the lump: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.

title: Romans 11:17
text: But if some of the branches were broken off, and thou, being a wild olive, wast grafted in among them, and didst become partaker with them of the root of the fatness of the olive tree;

title: Romans 11:18
text: glory not over the branches: but if thou gloriest, it is not thou that bearest the root, but the root thee.

title: Romans 11:19
text: Thou wilt say then, Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.

title: Romans 11:20
text: Well; by their unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by thy faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

title: Romans 11:21
text: for if God spared not the natural branches, neither will he spare thee.

title: Romans 11:22
text: Behold then the goodness and severity of God: toward them that fell, severity; but toward thee, God's goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

title: Romans 11:23
text: And they also, if they continue not in their unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.

title: Romans 11:24
text: For if thou wast cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and wast grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree; how much more shall these, which are the natural [branches], be grafted into their own olive tree?

title: Romans 11:25
text: For I would not, brethren, have you ignorant of this mystery, lest ye be wise in your own conceits, that a hardening in part hath befallen Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in;

title: Romans 11:26
text: and so all Israel shall be saved: even as it is written, There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer; He shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

title: Romans 11:27
text: And this is my covenant unto them, When I shall take away their sins.

title: Romans 11:28
text: As touching the gospel, they are enemies for your sake: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sake.

title: Romans 11:29
text: For the gifts and the calling of God are not repented of.

title: Romans 11:30
text: For as ye in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

title: Romans 11:31
text: even so have these also now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they also may now obtain mercy.

title: Romans 11:32
text: For God hath shut up all unto disobedience, that he might have mercy upon all.

title: Romans 11:33
text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

title: Romans 11:34
text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

title: Romans 11:35
text: or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

title: Romans 11:36
text: For of him, and through him, and unto him, are all things. To him [be] the glory for ever. Amen.

title: Romans 12:1
text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] your spiritual service.

title: Romans 12:2
text: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, and ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

title: Romans 12:3
text: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think as to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to each man a measure of faith.

title: Romans 12:4
text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members have not the same office:

title: Romans 12:5
text: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and severally members one of another.

title: Romans 12:6
text: And having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, whether prophecy, [let us prophesy] according to the proportion of our faith;

title: Romans 12:7
text: or ministry, [let us give ourselves] to our ministry; or he that teacheth, to his teaching;

title: Romans 12:8
text: or he that exhorteth, to his exhorting: he that giveth, [let him do it] with liberality; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness.

title: Romans 12:9
text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

title: Romans 12:10
text: In love of the brethren be tenderly affectioned one to another; in honor preferring one another;

title: Romans 12:11
text: in diligence not slothful; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

title: Romans 12:12
text: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;

title: Romans 12:13
text: communicating to the necessities of the saints; given to hospitality.

title: Romans 12:14
text: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.

title: Romans 12:15
text: Rejoice with them that rejoice; weep with them that weep.

title: Romans 12:16
text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Set not your mind on high things, but condescend to things that are lowly. Be not wise in your own conceits.

title: Romans 12:17
text: Render to no man evil for evil. Take thought for things honorable in the sight of all men.

title: Romans 12:18
text: If it be possible, as much as in you lieth, be at peace with all men.

title: Romans 12:19
text: Avenge not yourselves, beloved, but give place unto the wrath [of God]: for it is written, Vengeance belongeth unto me; I will recompense, saith the Lord.

title: Romans 12:20
text: But if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him to drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.

title: Romans 12:21
text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

title: Romans 13:1
text: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher powers: for there is no power but of God; and the [powers] that be are ordained of God.

title: Romans 13:2
text: Therefore he that resisteth the power, withstandeth the ordinance of God: and they that withstand shall receive to themselves judgment.

title: Romans 13:3
text: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. And wouldest thou have no fear of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise from the same:

title: Romans 13:4
text: for he is a minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is a minister of God, an avenger for wrath to him that doeth evil.

title: Romans 13:5
text: Wherefore [ye] must needs be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

title: Romans 13:6
text: For this cause ye pay tribute also; for they are ministers of God's service, attending continually upon this very thing.

title: Romans 13:7
text: Render to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute [is due]; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honor to whom honor.

title: Romans 13:8
text: Owe no man anything, save to love one another: for he that loveth his neighbor hath fulfilled the law.

title: Romans 13:9
text: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not covet, and if there be any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Romans 13:10
text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbor: love therefore is the fulfilment of the law.

title: Romans 13:11
text: And this, knowing the season, that already it is time for you to awake out of sleep: for now is salvation nearer to us than when we [first] believed.

title: Romans 13:12
text: The night is far spent, and the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.

title: Romans 13:13
text: Let us walk becomingly, as in the day; not in revelling and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and jealousy.

title: Romans 13:14
text: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to [fulfil] the lusts [thereof].

title: Romans 14:1
text: But him that is weak in faith receive ye, [yet] not for decision of scruples.

title: Romans 14:2
text: One man hath faith to eat all things: but he that is weak eateth herbs.

title: Romans 14:3
text: Let not him that eateth set at nought him that eateth not; and let not him that eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

title: Romans 14:4
text: Who art thou that judgest the servant of another? to his own lord he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be made to stand; for the Lord hath power to make him stand.

title: Romans 14:5
text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

title: Romans 14:6
text: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord: and he that eateth, eateth unto the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, unto the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

title: Romans 14:7
text: For none of us liveth to himself, and none dieth to himself.

title: Romans 14:8
text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; or whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

title: Romans 14:9
text: For to this end Christ died and lived [again], that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

title: Romans 14:10
text: But thou, why dost thou judge thy brother? or thou again, why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment-seat of God.

title: Romans 14:11
text: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, to me every knee shall bow, And every tongue shall confess to God.

title: Romans 14:12
text: So then each one of us shall give account of himself to God.

title: Romans 14:13
text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge ye this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock in his brother's way, or an occasion of falling.

title: Romans 14:14
text: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself: save that to him who accounteth anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

title: Romans 14:15
text: For if because of meat thy brother is grieved, thou walkest no longer in love. Destroy not with thy meat him for whom Christ died.

title: Romans 14:16
text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

title: Romans 14:17
text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 14:18
text: For he that herein serveth Christ is well-pleasing to God, and approved of men.

title: Romans 14:19
text: So then let us follow after things which make for peace, and things whereby we may edify one another.

title: Romans 14:20
text: Overthrow not for meat's sake the work of God. All things indeed are clean; howbeit it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

title: Romans 14:21
text: It is good not to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [to do anything] whereby thy brother stumbleth.

title: Romans 14:22
text: The faith which thou hast, have thou to thyself before God. Happy is he that judgeth not himself in that which he approveth.

title: Romans 14:23
text: But he that doubteth is condemned if he eat, because [he eateth] not of faith; and whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

title: Romans 15:1
text: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

title: Romans 15:2
text: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, unto edifying.

title: Romans 15:3
text: For Christ also pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell upon me.

title: Romans 15:4
text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that through patience and through comfort of the scriptures we might have hope.

title: Romans 15:5
text: Now the God of patience and of comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus:

title: Romans 15:6
text: that with one accord ye may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 15:7
text: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.

title: Romans 15:8
text: For I say that Christ hath been made a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises [given] unto the fathers,

title: Romans 15:9
text: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.

title: Romans 15:10
text: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

title: Romans 15:11
text: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.

title: Romans 15:12
text: And again, Isaiah saith, There shall be the root of Jesse, And he that ariseth to rule over the Gentiles; On him shall the Gentiles hope.

title: Romans 15:13
text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:14
text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

title: Romans 15:15
text: But I write the more boldly unto you in some measure, as putting you again in remembrance, because of the grace that was given me of God,

title: Romans 15:16
text: that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus unto the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:17
text: I have therefore my glorifying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

title: Romans 15:18
text: For I will not dare to speak of any things save those which Christ wrought through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

title: Romans 15:19
text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round about even unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ;

title: Romans 15:20
text: yea, making it my aim so to preach the gospel, not where Christ was [already] named, that I might not build upon another man's foundation;

title: Romans 15:21
text: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.

title: Romans 15:22
text: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:

title: Romans 15:23
text: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,

title: Romans 15:24
text: whensoever I go unto Spain (for I hope to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first in some measure I shall have been satisfied with your company)--

title: Romans 15:25
text: but now, I [say], I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.

title: Romans 15:26
text: For it hath been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints that are at Jerusalem.

title: Romans 15:27
text: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it [to them] also to minister unto them in carnal things.

title: Romans 15:28
text: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.

title: Romans 15:29
text: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.

title: Romans 15:30
text: Now I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

title: Romans 15:31
text: that I may be delivered from them that are disobedient in Judaea, and [that] my ministration which [I have] for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

title: Romans 15:32
text: that I may come unto you in joy through the will of God, and together with you find rest.

title: Romans 15:33
text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

title: Romans 16:1
text: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreae:

title: Romans 16:2
text: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.

title: Romans 16:3
text: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,

title: Romans 16:4
text: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:

title: Romans 16:5
text: and [salute] the church that is in their house. Salute Epaenetus my beloved, who is the first-fruits of Asia unto Christ.

title: Romans 16:6
text: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.

title: Romans 16:7
text: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.

title: Romans 16:8
text: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.

title: Romans 16:9
text: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

title: Romans 16:10
text: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the [household] of Aristobulus.

title: Romans 16:11
text: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the [household] of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.

title: Romans 16:12
text: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

title: Romans 16:13
text: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

title: Romans 16:14
text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.

title: Romans 16:15
text: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.

title: Romans 16:16
text: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.

title: Romans 16:17
text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.

title: Romans 16:18
text: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.

title: Romans 16:19
text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.

title: Romans 16:20
text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

title: Romans 16:21
text: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.

title: Romans 16:22
text: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.

title: Romans 16:23
text: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.

title: Romans 16:24
text: [The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.]

title: Romans 16:25
text: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,

title: Romans 16:26
text: but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:

title: Romans 16:27
text: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.

title: I Corinthians 1:1
text: Paul, called [to be] an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

title: I Corinthians 1:2
text: unto the church of God which is at Corinth, [even] them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called [to be] saints, with all that call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, their [Lord] and ours:

title: I Corinthians 1:3
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:4
text: I thank my God always concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;

title: I Corinthians 1:5
text: that in everything ye were enriched in him, in all utterance and all knowledge;

title: I Corinthians 1:6
text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

title: I Corinthians 1:7
text: so that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: I Corinthians 1:8
text: who shall also confirm you unto the end, [that ye be] unreproveable in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:9
text: God is faithful, through whom ye were called into the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 1:10
text: Now I beseech you, brethren, through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing and [that] there be no divisions among you; but [that] ye be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

title: I Corinthians 1:11
text: For it hath been signified unto me concerning you, my brethren, by them [that are of the household] of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

title: I Corinthians 1:12
text: Now this I mean, that each one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos: and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:13
text: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized into the name of Paul?

title: I Corinthians 1:14
text: I thank God that I baptized none of you, save Crispus and Gaius;

title: I Corinthians 1:15
text: lest any man should say that ye were baptized into my name.

title: I Corinthians 1:16
text: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

title: I Corinthians 1:17
text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not in wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made void.

title: I Corinthians 1:18
text: For the word of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us who are saved it is the power of God.

title: I Corinthians 1:19
text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, And the discernment of the discerning will I bring to nought.

title: I Corinthians 1:20
text: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

title: I Corinthians 1:21
text: For seeing that in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom knew not God, it was God's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save them that believe.

title: I Corinthians 1:22
text: Seeing that Jews ask for signs, and Greeks seek after wisdom:

title: I Corinthians 1:23
text: but we preach Christ crucified, unto Jews a stumblingblock, and unto Gentiles foolishness;

title: I Corinthians 1:24
text: but unto them that are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.

title: I Corinthians 1:25
text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

title: I Corinthians 1:26
text: For behold your calling, brethren, that not many wise after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, [are called]:

title: I Corinthians 1:27
text: but God chose the foolish things of the world, that he might put to shame them that are wise; and God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;

title: I Corinthians 1:28
text: and the base things of the world, and the things that are despised, did God choose, [yea] and the things that are not, that he might bring to nought the things that are:

title: I Corinthians 1:29
text: that no flesh should glory before God.

title: I Corinthians 1:30
text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who was made unto us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:

title: I Corinthians 1:31
text: that, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 2:1
text: And I, brethren, when I came unto you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:2
text: For I determined not to know anything among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

title: I Corinthians 2:3
text: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

title: I Corinthians 2:4
text: And my speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

title: I Corinthians 2:5
text: that your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:6
text: We speak wisdom, however, among them that are fullgrown: yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nought:

title: I Corinthians 2:7
text: but we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, [even] the [wisdom] that hath been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds unto our glory:

title: I Corinthians 2:8
text: which none of the rulers of this world hath known: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory:

title: I Corinthians 2:9
text: but as it is written, Things which eye saw not, and ear heard not, And [which] entered not into the heart of man, Whatsoever things God prepared for them that love him.

title: I Corinthians 2:10
text: But unto us God revealed [them] through the Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:11
text: For who among men knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of the man, which is in him? even so the things of God none knoweth, save the Spirit of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:12
text: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is from God; that we might know the things that were freely given to us of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:13
text: Which things also we speak, not in words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Spirit teacheth; combining spiritual things with spiritual [words].

title: I Corinthians 2:14
text: Now the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him; and he cannot know them, because they are spiritually judged.

title: I Corinthians 2:15
text: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, and he himself is judged of no man.

title: I Corinthians 2:16
text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:1
text: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, as unto babes in Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:2
text: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for ye were not yet able [to bear it]: nay, not even now are ye able;
