text: and in him ye are made full, who is the head of all principality and power:

title: Colossians 2:11
text: in whom ye were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

title: Colossians 2:12
text: having been buried with him in baptism, wherein ye were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

title: Colossians 2:13
text: And you, being dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, you, [I say], did he make alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses;

title: Colossians 2:14
text: having blotted out the bond written in ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us: and he hath taken it out that way, nailing it to the cross;

title: Colossians 2:15
text: having despoiled the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

title: Colossians 2:16
text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of a feast day or a new moon or a sabbath day:

title: Colossians 2:17
text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.

title: Colossians 2:18
text: Let no man rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he hath seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

title: Colossians 2:19
text: and not holding fast the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and bands, increasing with the increase of God.

title: Colossians 2:20
text: If ye died with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, do ye subject yourselves to ordinances,

title: Colossians 2:21
text: Handle not, nor taste, nor touch

title: Colossians 2:22
text: (all which things are to perish with the using), after the precepts and doctrines of men?

title: Colossians 2:23
text: Which things have indeed a show of wisdom in will-worship, and humility, and severity to the body; [but are] not of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

title: Colossians 3:1
text: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

title: Colossians 3:2
text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.

title: Colossians 3:3
text: For ye died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

title: Colossians 3:4
text: When Christ, [who is] our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.

title: Colossians 3:5
text: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

title: Colossians 3:6
text: for which things' sake cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience:

title: Colossians 3:7
text: wherein ye also once walked, when ye lived in these things;

title: Colossians 3:8
text: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:

title: Colossians 3:9
text: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,

title: Colossians 3:10
text: and have put on the new man, that is being renewed unto knowledge after the image of him that created him:

title: Colossians 3:11
text: where there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondman, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

title: Colossians 3:12
text: Put on therefore, as God's elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;

title: Colossians 3:13
text: forbearing one another, and forgiving each other, if any man have a complaint against any; even as the Lord forgave you, so also do ye:

title: Colossians 3:14
text: and above all these things [put on] love, which is the bond of perfectness.

title: Colossians 3:15
text: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.

title: Colossians 3:16
text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms [and] hymns [and] spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto God.

title: Colossians 3:17
text: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, [do] all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

title: Colossians 3:18
text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

title: Colossians 3:19
text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

title: Colossians 3:20
text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.

title: Colossians 3:21
text: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.

title: Colossians 3:22
text: Servants, obey in all things them that are your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing the Lord:

title: Colossians 3:23
text: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;

title: Colossians 3:24
text: knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the recompense of the inheritance: ye serve the Lord Christ.

title: Colossians 3:25
text: For he that doeth wrong shall receive again for the wrong that he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

title: Colossians 4:1
text: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

title: Colossians 4:2
text: Continue stedfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

title: Colossians 4:3
text: withal praying for us also, that God may open unto us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

title: Colossians 4:4
text: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

title: Colossians 4:5
text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

title: Colossians 4:6
text: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer each one.

title: Colossians 4:7
text: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:

title: Colossians 4:8
text: whom I have sent you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts;

title: Colossians 4:9
text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that [are done] here.

title: Colossians 4:10
text: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner saluteth you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (touching whom ye received commandments; if he come unto you, receive him),

title: Colossians 4:11
text: and Jesus that is called Justus, who are of the circumcision: these only [are my] fellow-workers unto the kingdom of God, men that have been a comfort unto me.

title: Colossians 4:12
text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, saluteth you, always striving for you in his prayers, that ye may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God.

title: Colossians 4:13
text: For I bear him witness, that he hath much labor for you, and for them in Laodicea, and for them in Hierapolis.

title: Colossians 4:14
text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas salute you.

title: Colossians 4:15
text: Salute the brethren that are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church that is in their house.

title: Colossians 4:16
text: And when this epistle hath been read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye also read the epistle from Laodicea.

title: Colossians 4:17
text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

title: Colossians 4:18
text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you.

title: I Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

title: I Thessalonians 1:2
text: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention [of you] in our prayers;

title: I Thessalonians 1:3
text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

title: I Thessalonians 1:4
text: knowing, brethren beloved of God, your election,

title: I Thessalonians 1:5
text: how that our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and [in] much assurance; even as ye know what manner of men we showed ourselves toward you for your sake.

title: I Thessalonians 1:6
text: And ye became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit;

title: I Thessalonians 1:7
text: so that ye became an ensample to all that believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

title: I Thessalonians 1:8
text: For from you hath sounded forth the word of the Lord, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith to God-ward is gone forth; so that we need not to speak anything.

title: I Thessalonians 1:9
text: For they themselves report concerning us what manner of entering in we had unto you; and how ye turned unto God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

title: I Thessalonians 1:10
text: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, [even] Jesus, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.

title: I Thessalonians 2:1
text: For yourselves, brethren, know our entering in unto you, that it hath not been found vain:

title: I Thessalonians 2:2
text: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as ye know, at Philippi, we waxed bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God in much conflict.

title: I Thessalonians 2:3
text: For our exhortation [is] not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

title: I Thessalonians 2:4
text: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.

title: I Thessalonians 2:5
text: For neither at any time were we found using words of flattery, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness, God is witness;

title: I Thessalonians 2:6
text: nor seeking glory of men, neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

title: I Thessalonians 2:7
text: But we were gentle in the midst of you, as when a nurse cherisheth her own children:

title: I Thessalonians 2:8
text: even so, being affectionately desirous of you, we were well pleased to impart unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were become very dear to us.

title: I Thessalonians 2:9
text: For ye remember, brethren, our labor and travail: working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

title: I Thessalonians 2:10
text: Ye are witnesses, and God [also], how holily and righteously and unblameably we behaved ourselves toward you that believe:

title: I Thessalonians 2:11
text: as ye know how we [dealt with] each one of you, as a father with his own children, exhorting you, and encouraging [you], and testifying,

title: I Thessalonians 2:12
text: to the end that ye should walk worthily of God, who calleth you into his own kingdom and glory.

title: I Thessalonians 2:13
text: And for this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when ye received from us the word of the message, [even the word] of God, ye accepted [it] not [as] the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also worketh in you that believe.

title: I Thessalonians 2:14
text: For ye, brethren, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judaea in Christ Jesus: for ye also suffered the same things of your own countrymen, even as they did of the Jews;

title: I Thessalonians 2:15
text: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove out us, and pleased not God, and are contrary to all men;

title: I Thessalonians 2:16
text: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always: but the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

title: I Thessalonians 2:17
text: But we, brethren, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence not in heart, endeavored the more exceedingly to see your face with great desire:

title: I Thessalonians 2:18
text: because we would fain have come unto you, I Paul once and again; and Satan hindered us.

title: I Thessalonians 2:19
text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of glorying? Are not even ye, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

title: I Thessalonians 2:20
text: For ye are our glory and our joy.

title: I Thessalonians 3:1
text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone;

title: I Thessalonians 3:2
text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God's minister in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort [you] concerning your faith;

title: I Thessalonians 3:3
text: that no man be moved by these afflictions; for yourselves know that hereunto we are appointed.

title: I Thessalonians 3:4
text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

title: I Thessalonians 3:5
text: For this cause I also, when I could no longer forbear, sent that I might know your faith, lest by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor should be in vain.

title: I Thessalonians 3:6
text: But when Timothy came even now unto us from you, and brought us glad tidings of your faith and love, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, longing to see us, even as we also [to see] you;

title: I Thessalonians 3:7
text: for this cause, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith:

title: I Thessalonians 3:8
text: for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

title: I Thessalonians 3:9
text: For what thanksgiving can we render again unto God for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

title: I Thessalonians 3:10
text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

title: I Thessalonians 3:11
text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way unto you:

title: I Thessalonians 3:12
text: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also [do] toward you;

title: I Thessalonians 3:13
text: to the end he may establish your hearts unblameable in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

title: I Thessalonians 4:1
text: Finally then, brethren, we beseech and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that, as ye received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, even as ye do walk, --that ye abound more and more.

title: I Thessalonians 4:2
text: For ye know what charge we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

title: I Thessalonians 4:3
text: For this is the will of God, [even] your sanctification, that ye abstain from fornication;

title: I Thessalonians 4:4
text: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

title: I Thessalonians 4:5
text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who know not God;

title: I Thessalonians 4:6
text: that no man transgress, and wrong his brother in the matter: because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

title: I Thessalonians 4:7
text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

title: I Thessalonians 4:8
text: Therefore he that rejecteth, rejecteth not man, but God, who giveth his Holy Spirit unto you.

title: I Thessalonians 4:9
text: But concerning love of the brethren ye have no need that one write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another;

title: I Thessalonians 4:10
text: for indeed ye do it toward all the brethren that are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brethren, that ye abound more and more;

title: I Thessalonians 4:11
text: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your hands, even as we charged you;

title: I Thessalonians 4:12
text: that ye may walk becomingly toward them that are without, and may have need of nothing.

title: I Thessalonians 4:13
text: But we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning them that fall asleep; that ye sorrow not, even as the rest, who have no hope.

title: I Thessalonians 4:14
text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also that are fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

title: I Thessalonians 4:15
text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we that are alive, that are left unto the coming of the Lord, shall in no wise precede them that are fallen asleep.

title: I Thessalonians 4:16
text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first;

title: I Thessalonians 4:17
text: then we that are alive, that are left, shall together with them be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

title: I Thessalonians 4:18
text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

title: I Thessalonians 5:1
text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

title: I Thessalonians 5:2
text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

title: I Thessalonians 5:3
text: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

title: I Thessalonians 5:4
text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

title: I Thessalonians 5:5
text: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

title: I Thessalonians 5:6
text: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

title: I Thessalonians 5:7
text: For they that sleep sleep in the night: and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

title: I Thessalonians 5:8
text: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

title: I Thessalonians 5:9
text: For God appointed us not into wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: I Thessalonians 5:10
text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

title: I Thessalonians 5:11
text: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

title: I Thessalonians 5:12
text: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

title: I Thessalonians 5:13
text: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

title: I Thessalonians 5:14
text: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

title: I Thessalonians 5:15
text: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

title: I Thessalonians 5:16
text: Rejoice always;

title: I Thessalonians 5:17
text: pray without ceasing;

title: I Thessalonians 5:18
text: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

title: I Thessalonians 5:19
text: Quench not the Spirit;

title: I Thessalonians 5:20
text: despise not prophesyings;

title: I Thessalonians 5:21
text: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

title: I Thessalonians 5:22
text: abstain from every form of evil.

title: I Thessalonians 5:23
text: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Thessalonians 5:24
text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

title: I Thessalonians 5:25
text: Brethren, pray for us.

title: I Thessalonians 5:26
text: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

title: I Thessalonians 5:27
text: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

title: I Thessalonians 5:28
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

title: II Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;

title: II Thessalonians 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 1:3
text: We are bound to give thanks to God always to you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith growth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;

title: II Thessalonians 1:4
text: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;

title: II Thessalonians 1:5
text: [which is] a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

title: II Thessalonians 1:6
text: if so be that it is righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,

title: II Thessalonians 1:7
text: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,

title: II Thessalonians 1:8
text: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:

title: II Thessalonians 1:9
text: who shall suffer punishment, [even] eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

title: II Thessalonians 1:10
text: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.

title: II Thessalonians 1:11
text: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and [every] work of faith, with power;

title: II Thessalonians 1:12
text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 2:1
text: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;

title: II Thessalonians 2:2
text: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;

title: II Thessalonians 2:3
text: let no man beguile you in any wise: for [it will not be,] except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,

title: II Thessalonians 2:4
text: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.

title: II Thessalonians 2:5
text: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

title: II Thessalonians 2:6
text: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

title: II Thessalonians 2:7
text: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only [there is] one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.

title: II Thessalonians 2:8
text: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;

title: II Thessalonians 2:9
text: [even he], whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

title: II Thessalonians 2:10
text: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

title: II Thessalonians 2:11
text: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:

title: II Thessalonians 2:12
text: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

title: II Thessalonians 2:13
text: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

title: II Thessalonians 2:14
text: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 2:15
text: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.

title: II Thessalonians 2:16
text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

title: II Thessalonians 2:17
text: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.

title: II Thessalonians 3:1
text: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also [it is] with you;

title: II Thessalonians 3:2
text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.

title: II Thessalonians 3:3
text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil [one].

title: II Thessalonians 3:4
text: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.

title: II Thessalonians 3:5
text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 3:6
text: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.

title: II Thessalonians 3:7
text: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

title: II Thessalonians 3:8
text: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man's hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:

title: II Thessalonians 3:9
text: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves and ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.

title: II Thessalonians 3:10
text: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.

title: II Thessalonians 3:11
text: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.

title: II Thessalonians 3:12
text: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

title: II Thessalonians 3:13
text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.

title: II Thessalonians 3:14
text: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

title: II Thessalonians 3:15
text: And [yet] count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

title: II Thessalonians 3:16
text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

title: II Thessalonians 3:17
text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

title: II Thessalonians 3:18
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

title: I Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Saviour, and Christ Jesus our hope;

title: I Timothy 1:2
text: unto Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: I Timothy 1:3
text: As I exhorted thee to tarry at Ephesus, when I was going into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

title: I Timothy 1:4
text: neither to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questionings, rather than a dispensation of God which is in faith; [so do I now].

title: I Timothy 1:5
text: But the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and faith unfeigned:

title: I Timothy 1:6
text: from which things some having swerved have turned aside unto vain talking;

title: I Timothy 1:7
text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor whereof they confidently affirm.

title: I Timothy 1:8
text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully,

title: I Timothy 1:9
text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and unruly, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

title: I Timothy 1:10
text: for fornicators, for abusers of themselves with men, for menstealers, for liars, for false swearers, and if there be any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;

title: I Timothy 1:11
text: according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

title: I Timothy 1:12
text: I thank him that enabled me, [even] Christ Jesus our Lord, for that he counted me faithful, appointing me to [his] service;

title: I Timothy 1:13
text: though I was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: howbeit I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief;

title: I Timothy 1:14
text: and the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

title: I Timothy 1:15
text: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief:

title: I Timothy 1:16
text: howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me as chief might Jesus Christ show forth all his longsuffering, for an ensample of them that should thereafter believe on him unto eternal life.

title: I Timothy 1:17
text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, [be] honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: I Timothy 1:18
text: This charge I commit unto thee, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to thee, that by them thou mayest war the good warfare;

title: I Timothy 1:19
text: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust from them made shipwreck concerning the faith:

title: I Timothy 1:20
text: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered unto Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

title: I Timothy 2:1
text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men;

title: I Timothy 2:2
text: for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.

title: I Timothy 2:3
text: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

title: I Timothy 2:4
text: who would have all men to be saved, and come to the knowledge of the truth.

title: I Timothy 2:5
text: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, [himself] man, Christ Jesus,

title: I Timothy 2:6
text: who gave himself a ransom for all; the testimony [to be borne] in its own times;

title: I Timothy 2:7
text: whereunto I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth, I lie not), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

title: I Timothy 2:8
text: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.

title: I Timothy 2:9
text: In like manner, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with braided hair, and gold or pearls or costly raiment;

title: I Timothy 2:10
text: but (which becometh women professing godliness) through good works.

title: I Timothy 2:11
text: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

title: I Timothy 2:12
text: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.

title: I Timothy 2:13
text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

title: I Timothy 2:14
text: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:

title: I Timothy 2:15
text: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.

title: I Timothy 3:1
text: Faithful is the saying, If a man seeketh the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

title: I Timothy 3:2
text: The bishop therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, orderly, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

title: I Timothy 3:3
text: no brawler, no striker; but gentle, not contentious, no lover of money;

title: I Timothy 3:4
text: one that ruleth well his own house, having [his] children in subjection with all gravity;

title: I Timothy 3:5
text: (but if a man knoweth not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

title: I Timothy 3:6
text: not a novice, lest being puffed up he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

title: I Timothy 3:7
text: Moreover he must have good testimony from them that are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

title: I Timothy 3:8
text: Deacons in like manner [must be] grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

title: I Timothy 3:9
text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

title: I Timothy 3:10
text: And let these also first be proved; then let them serve as deacons, if they be blameless.

title: I Timothy 3:11
text: Women in like manner [must be] grave, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.

title: I Timothy 3:12
text: Let deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling [their] children and their own houses well.

title: I Timothy 3:13
text: For they that have served well as deacons gain to themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

title: I Timothy 3:14
text: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly;

title: I Timothy 3:15
text: but if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how men ought to behave themselves in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

title: I Timothy 3:16
text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness; He who was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the spirit, Seen of angels, Preached among the nations, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.

title: I Timothy 4:1
text: But the Spirit saith expressly, that in later times some shall fall away from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

title: I Timothy 4:2
text: through the hypocrisy of men that speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;

title: I Timothy 4:3
text: forbidding to marry, [and commanding] to abstain from meats, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by them that believe and know the truth.

title: I Timothy 4:4
text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it be received with thanksgiving:

title: I Timothy 4:5
text: for it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

title: I Timothy 4:6
text: If thou put the brethren in mind of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which thou hast followed [until now]:

title: I Timothy 4:7
text: but refuse profane and old wives' fables. And exercise thyself unto godliness:

title: I Timothy 4:8
text: for bodily exercise is profitable for a little; but godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life which now is, and of that which is to come.

title: I Timothy 4:9
text: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation.

title: I Timothy 4:10
text: For to this end we labor and strive, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of them that believe.

title: I Timothy 4:11
text: These things command and teach.

title: I Timothy 4:12
text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.

title: I Timothy 4:13
text: Till I come, give heed to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

title: I Timothy 4:14
text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

title: I Timothy 4:15
text: Be diligent in these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy progress may be manifest unto all.

title: I Timothy 4:16
text: Take heed to thyself, and to thy teaching. Continue in these things; for in doing this thou shalt save both thyself and them that hear thee.

title: I Timothy 5:1
text: Rebuke not an elder, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brethren:

title: I Timothy 5:2
text: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

title: I Timothy 5:3
text: Honor widows that are widows indeed.

title: I Timothy 5:4
text: But if any widow hath children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to requite their parents: for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

title: I Timothy 5:5
text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, hath her hope set on God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

title: I Timothy 5:6
text: But she that giveth herself to pleasure is dead while she liveth.

title: I Timothy 5:7
text: These things also command, that they may be without reproach.

title: I Timothy 5:8
text: But if any provideth not for his own, and specially his own household, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.

title: I Timothy 5:9
text: Let none be enrolled as a widow under threescore years old, [having been] the wife of one man,

title: I Timothy 5:10
text: well reported of for good works; if she hath brought up children, if she hath used hospitality to strangers, if she hath washed the saints' feet, if she hath relieved the afflicted, if she hath diligently followed every good work.

title: I Timothy 5:11
text: But younger widows refuse: for when they have waxed wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;

title: I Timothy 5:12
text: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

title: I Timothy 5:13
text: And withal they learn also [to be] idle, going about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

title: I Timothy 5:14
text: I desire therefore that the younger [widows] marry, bear children, rule the household, give no occasion to the adversary for reviling:

title: I Timothy 5:15
text: for already some are turned aside after Satan.

title: I Timothy 5:16
text: If any woman that believeth hath widows, let her relieve them, and let not the church be burdened; that it mat relieve them that are widows indeed.

title: I Timothy 5:17
text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

title: I Timothy 5:18
text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. And, The laborer is worthy of his hire.

title: I Timothy 5:19
text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, except at [the mouth of] two or three witnesses.

title: I Timothy 5:20
text: Them that sin reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

title: I Timothy 5:21
text: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

title: I Timothy 5:22
text: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

title: I Timothy 5:23
text: Be no longer a drinker of water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

title: I Timothy 5:24
text: Some men's sins are evident, going before unto judgment; and some men also they follow after.

title: I Timothy 5:25
text: In like manner also there are good works that are evident; and such as are otherwise cannot be hid.

title: I Timothy 6:1
text: Let as many as are servants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine be not blasphemed.

title: I Timothy 6:2
text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but let them serve them the rather, because they that partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. These things teach and exhort.

title: I Timothy 6:3
text: If any man teacheth a different doctrine, and consenteth not to sound words, [even] the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

title: I Timothy 6:4
text: he is puffed up, knowing nothing, but doting about questionings and disputes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

title: I Timothy 6:5
text: wranglings of men corrupted in mind and bereft of the truth, supposing that godliness is a way of gain.

title: I Timothy 6:6
text: But godliness with contentment is great gain:

title: I Timothy 6:7
text: for we brought nothing into the world, for neither can we carry anything out;

title: I Timothy 6:8
text: but having food and covering we shall be therewith content.

title: I Timothy 6:9
text: But they that are minded to be rich fall into a temptation and a snare and many foolish and hurtful lusts, such as drown men in destruction and perdition.

title: I Timothy 6:10
text: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil: which some reaching after have been led astray from the faith, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

title: I Timothy 6:11
text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

title: I Timothy 6:12
text: Fight the good fight of the faith, lay hold on the life eternal, whereunto thou wast called, and didst confess the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

title: I Timothy 6:13
text: I charge thee in the sight of God, who giveth life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed the good confession;

title: I Timothy 6:14
text: that thou keep the commandment, without spot, without reproach, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

title: I Timothy 6:15
text: which in its own times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

title: I Timothy 6:16
text: who only hath immortality, dwelling in light unapproachable; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom [be] honor and power eternal. Amen.

title: I Timothy 6:17
text: Charge them that are rich in this present world, that they be not highminded, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

title: I Timothy 6:18
text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

title: I Timothy 6:19
text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on the life which is [life] indeed.

title: I Timothy 6:20
text: O Timothy, guard that which is committed unto [thee], turning away from the profane babblings and oppositions of the knowledge which is falsely so called;

title: I Timothy 6:21
text: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you.

title: II Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

title: II Timothy 1:2
text: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: II Timothy 1:3
text: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day

title: II Timothy 1:4
text: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

title: II Timothy 1:5
text: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.

title: II Timothy 1:6
text: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.

title: II Timothy 1:7
text: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.

title: II Timothy 1:8
text: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;

title: II Timothy 1:9
text: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

title: II Timothy 1:10
text: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,

title: II Timothy 1:11
text: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.

title: II Timothy 1:12
text: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.

title: II Timothy 1:13
text: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 1:14
text: That good thing which was committed unto [thee] guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.

title: II Timothy 1:15
text: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

title: II Timothy 1:16
text: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;

title: II Timothy 1:17
text: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

title: II Timothy 1:18
text: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

title: II Timothy 2:1
text: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 2:2
text: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

title: II Timothy 2:3
text: Suffer hardship with [me], as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 2:4
text: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of [this] life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

title: II Timothy 2:5
text: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowded, except he have contended lawfully.

title: II Timothy 2:6
text: The husbandmen that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.

title: II Timothy 2:7
text: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.

title: II Timothy 2:8
text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:

title: II Timothy 2:9
text: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.

title: II Timothy 2:10
text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

title: II Timothy 2:11
text: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:

title: II Timothy 2:12
text: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:

title: II Timothy 2:13
text: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.

title: II Timothy 2:14
text: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging [them] in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.

title: II Timothy 2:15
text: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.

title: II Timothy 2:16
text: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,

title: II Timothy 2:17
text: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: or whom is Hymenaeus an Philetus;

title: II Timothy 2:18
text: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.

title: II Timothy 2:19
text: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

title: II Timothy 2:20
text: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.

title: II Timothy 2:21
text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master's use, prepared unto every good work.

title: II Timothy 2:22
text: after righteousness, faith, love, pace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

title: II Timothy 2:23
text: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.

title: II Timothy 2:24
text: And the Lord's servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,

title: II Timothy 2:25
text: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,

title: II Timothy 2:26
text: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.

title: II Timothy 3:1
text: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.

title: II Timothy 3:2
text: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

title: II Timothy 3:3
text: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

title: II Timothy 3:4
text: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

title: II Timothy 3:5
text: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power therefore. From these also turn away.

title: II Timothy 3:6
text: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,

title: II Timothy 3:7
text: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

title: II Timothy 3:8
text: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth. Men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

title: II Timothy 3:9
text: But they shall proceed no further. For their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.

title: II Timothy 3:10
text: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,

title: II Timothy 3:11
text: persecutions, sufferings. What things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.

title: II Timothy 3:12
text: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

title: II Timothy 3:13
text: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

title: II Timothy 3:14
text: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them.

title: II Timothy 3:15
text: And that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 3:16
text: Every scripture inspired of God [is] also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness.

title: II Timothy 3:17
text: That the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.

title: II Timothy 4:1
text: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

title: II Timothy 4:2
text: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

title: II Timothy 4:3
text: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;

title: II Timothy 4:4
text: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.

title: II Timothy 4:5
text: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.

title: II Timothy 4:6
text: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.

title: II Timothy 4:7
text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:

title: II Timothy 4:8
text: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.

title: II Timothy 4:9
text: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:

title: II Timothy 4:10
text: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

title: II Timothy 4:11
text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.

title: II Timothy 4:12
text: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

title: II Timothy 4:13
text: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.

title: II Timothy 4:14
text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:

title: II Timothy 4:15
text: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.

title: II Timothy 4:16
text: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.

title: II Timothy 4:17
text: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might me fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

title: II Timothy 4:18
text: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom [be] the glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: II Timothy 4:19
text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

title: II Timothy 4:20
text: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.

title: II Timothy 4:21
text: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

title: II Timothy 4:22
text: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.

title: Titus 1:1
text: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

title: Titus 1:2
text: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;

title: Titus 1:3
text: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

title: Titus 1:4
text: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

title: Titus 1:5
text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;

title: Titus 1:6
text: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.

title: Titus 1:7
text: For the bishop must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;

title: Titus 1:8
text: but given to hospitality, as lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;

title: Titus 1:9
text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.

title: Titus 1:10
text: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,

title: Titus 1:11
text: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

title: Titus 1:12
text: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.

title: Titus 1:13
text: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

title: Titus 1:14
text: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

title: Titus 1:15
text: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

title: Titus 1:16
text: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

title: Titus 2:1
text: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:

title: Titus 2:2
text: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:

title: Titus 2:3
text: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

title: Titus 2:4
text: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

title: Titus 2:5
text: [to be] sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:

title: Titus 2:6
text: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:

title: Titus 2:7
text: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine [showing] uncorruptness, gravity,

title: Titus 2:8
text: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.

title: Titus 2:9
text: [Exhort] servants to be in subjection to their own masters, [and] to be well-pleasing [to them] in all things; not gainsaying;

title: Titus 2:10
text: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

title: Titus 2:11
text: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

title: Titus 2:12
text: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;

title: Titus 2:13
text: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

title: Titus 2:14
text: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.

title: Titus 2:15
text: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

title: Titus 3:1
text: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,

title: Titus 3:2
text: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.

title: Titus 3:3
text: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

title: Titus 3:4
text: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,

title: Titus 3:5
text: not by works [done] in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,

title: Titus 3:6
text: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

title: Titus 3:7
text: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

title: Titus 3:8
text: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:

title: Titus 3:9
text: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

title: Titus 3:10
text: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;

title: Titus 3:11
text: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.

title: Titus 3:12
text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.

title: Titus 3:13
text: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

title: Titus 3:14
text: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

title: Titus 3:15
text: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.

title: Philemon 1:1
text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,

title: Philemon 1:2
text: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house:

title: Philemon 1:3
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Philemon 1:4
text: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,

title: Philemon 1:5
text: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

title: Philemon 1:6
text: that the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you, unto Christ.

title: Philemon 1:7
text: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.

title: Philemon 1:8
text: Wherefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to enjoin thee that which is befitting,

title: Philemon 1:9
text: yet for love's sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now a prisoner also of Christ Jesus:

title: Philemon 1:10
text: I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,

title: Philemon 1:11
text: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:

title: Philemon 1:12
text: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:

title: Philemon 1:13
text: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

title: Philemon 1:14
text: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.

title: Philemon 1:15
text: For perhaps he was therefore parted [from thee] for a season, that thou shouldest have him for ever;

title: Philemon 1:16
text: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

title: Philemon 1:17
text: If then thou countest me a partner, receive him as myself.

title: Philemon 1:18
text: But if he hath wronged the at all, or oweth [thee] aught, put that to mine account;

title: Philemon 1:19
text: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it: that I say not unto thee that thou owest to me even thine own self besides.

title: Philemon 1:20
text: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.

title: Philemon 1:21
text: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.

title: Philemon 1:22
text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.

title: Philemon 1:23
text: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, saluteth thee;

title: Philemon 1:24
text: [and so do] Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workers.

title: Philemon 1:25
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

title: Hebrews 1:1
text: God, having of old time spoken unto the fathers in the prophets by divers portions and in divers manners,

title: Hebrews 1:2
text: hath at the end of these days spoken unto us in [his] Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds;

title: Hebrews 1:3
text: who being the effulgence of his glory, and the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had made purification of sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

title: Hebrews 1:4
text: having become by so much better than the angels, as he hath inherited a more excellent name than they.

title: Hebrews 1:5
text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, This day have I begotten thee? and again, I will be to him a Father, And he shall be to me a Son?

title: Hebrews 1:6
text: And when he again bringeth in the firstborn into the world he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

title: Hebrews 1:7
text: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels winds, And his ministers a flame a fire:

title: Hebrews 1:8
text: but of the Son [he saith,] Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; And the sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

title: Hebrews 1:9
text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

title: Hebrews 1:10
text: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning didst lay the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the works of thy hands:

title: Hebrews 1:11
text: They shall perish; but thou continuest: And they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

title: Hebrews 1:12
text: And as a mantle shalt thou roll them up, As a garment, and they shall be changed: But thou art the same, And thy years shall not fail.

title: Hebrews 1:13
text: But of which of the angels hath he said at any time, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet?

title: Hebrews 1:14
text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to do service for the sake of them that shall inherit salvation?

title: Hebrews 2:1
text: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things that were heard, lest haply we drift away [from them].

title: Hebrews 2:2
text: For if the word spoken through angels proved stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward;

title: Hebrews 2:3
text: how shall we escape, if we neglect so great a salvation? which having at the first been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed unto us by them that heard;

title: Hebrews 2:4
text: God also bearing witness with them, both by signs and wonders, and by manifold powers, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will.

title: Hebrews 2:5
text: For not unto angels did he subject the world to come, whereof we speak.

title: Hebrews 2:6
text: But one hath somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? Or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

title: Hebrews 2:7
text: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; Thou crownedst him with glory and honor, And didst set him over the works of thy hands:

title: Hebrews 2:8
text: Thou didst put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he subjected all things unto him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we see not yet all things subjected to him.

title: Hebrews 2:9
text: But we behold him who hath been made a little lower than the angels, [even] Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for every [man].

title: Hebrews 2:10
text: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

title: Hebrews 2:11
text: For both he that sanctifieth and they that are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

title: Hebrews 2:12
text: saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, In the midst of the congregation will I sing thy praise.

title: Hebrews 2:13
text: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold, I and the children whom God hath given me.

title: Hebrews 2:14
text: Since then the children are sharers in flesh and blood, he also himself in like manner partook of the same; that through death he might bring to nought him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

title: Hebrews 2:15
text: and might deliver all them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

title: Hebrews 2:16
text: For verily not to angels doth he give help, but he giveth help to the seed of Abraham.

title: Hebrews 2:17
text: Wherefore it behooved him in all things to be made like unto his brethren, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.

title: Hebrews 2:18
text: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succor them that are tempted.

title: Hebrews 3:1
text: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, [even] Jesus;

title: Hebrews 3:2
text: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

title: Hebrews 3:3
text: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.

title: Hebrews 3:4
text: For every house is builded by some one; but he that built all things is God.

title: Hebrews 3:5
text: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken;

title: Hebrews 3:6
text: but Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we hold fast our boldness and the glorying of our hope firm unto the end.

title: Hebrews 3:7
text: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,

title: Hebrews 3:8
text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

title: Hebrews 3:9
text: Where your fathers tried [me] by proving [me,] And saw my works forty years.

title: Hebrews 3:10
text: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;

title: Hebrews 3:11
text: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.

title: Hebrews 3:12
text: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:

title: Hebrews 3:13
text: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:

title: Hebrews 3:14
text: for we are become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm unto the end:

title: Hebrews 3:15
text: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

title: Hebrews 3:16
text: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?

title: Hebrews 3:17
text: And with whom was he displeased forty years? was it not with them that sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

title: Hebrews 3:18
text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that were disobedient?

title: Hebrews 3:19
text: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

title: Hebrews 4:1
text: Let us fear therefore, lest haply, a promise being left of entering into his rest, any one of you should seem to have come short of it.

title: Hebrews 4:2
text: For indeed we have had good tidings preached unto us, even as also they: but the word of hearing did not profit them, because it was not united by faith with them that heard.

title: Hebrews 4:3
text: For we who have believed do enter into that rest; even as he hath said, As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

title: Hebrews 4:4
text: For he hath said somewhere of the seventh [day] on this wise, And God rested on the seventh day from all his works;

title: Hebrews 4:5
text: and in this [place] again, They shall not enter into my rest.

title: Hebrews 4:6
text: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some should enter thereinto, and they to whom the good tidings were before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

title: Hebrews 4:7
text: he again defineth a certain day, To-day, saying in David so long a time afterward (even as hath been said before), To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts.

title: Hebrews 4:8
text: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

title: Hebrews 4:9
text: There remaineth therefore a sabbath rest for the people of God.

title: Hebrews 4:10
text: For he that is entered into his rest hath himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

title: Hebrews 4:11
text: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, that no man fall after the same example of disobedience.

title: Hebrews 4:12
text: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and quick to discern the thoughts and intents of the heart.

title: Hebrews 4:13
text: And there is no creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

title: Hebrews 4:14
text: Having then a great high priest, who hath passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.

title: Hebrews 4:15
text: For we have not a high priest that cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but one that hath been in all points tempted like as [we are, yet] without sin.

title: Hebrews 4:16
text: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help [us] in time of need.

title: Hebrews 5:1
text: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

title: Hebrews 5:2
text: who can bear gently with the ignorant and erring, for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity;

title: Hebrews 5:3
text: and by reason thereof is bound, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

title: Hebrews 5:4
text: And no man taketh the honor unto himself, but when he is called of God, even as was Aaron.

title: Hebrews 5:5
text: So Christ also glorified not himself to be made a high priest, but he that spake unto him, Thou art my Son, This day have I begotten thee:

title: Hebrews 5:6
text: as he saith also in another [place,] Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

title: Hebrews 5:7
text: Who in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

title: Hebrews 5:8
text: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered;

title: Hebrews 5:9
text: and having been made perfect, he became unto all them that obey him the author of eternal salvation;

title: Hebrews 5:10
text: named of God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

title: Hebrews 5:11
text: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard of interpretation, seeing ye are become dull of hearing.

title: Hebrews 5:12
text: For when by reason of the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need again that some one teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of solid food.

title: Hebrews 5:13
text: For every one that partaketh of milk is without experience of the word of righteousness; for he is a babe.

title: Hebrews 5:14
text: But solid food is for fullgrown men, [even] those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

title: Hebrews 6:1
text: Wherefore leaving the doctrine of the first principles of Christ, let us press on unto perfection; not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

title: Hebrews 6:2
text: of the teaching of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

title: Hebrews 6:3
text: And this will we do, if God permit.

title: Hebrews 6:4
text: For as touching those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

title: Hebrews 6:5
text: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

title: Hebrews 6:6
text: and [then] fell away, it is impossible to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

title: Hebrews 6:7
text: For the land which hath drunk the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receiveth blessing from God:

title: Hebrews 6:8
text: but if it beareth thorns and thistles, it is rejected and nigh unto a curse; whose end is to be burned.

title: Hebrews 6:9
text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak:

title: Hebrews 6:10
text: for God is not unrighteous to forget your work and the love which ye showed toward his name, in that ye ministered unto the saints, and still do minister.

title: Hebrews 6:11
text: And we desire that each one of you may show the same diligence unto the fulness of hope even to the end:

title: Hebrews 6:12
text: that ye be not sluggish, but imitators of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

title: Hebrews 6:13
text: For when God made promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he sware by himself,

title: Hebrews 6:14
text: saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

title: Hebrews 6:15
text: And thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

title: Hebrews 6:16
text: For men swear by the greater: and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

title: Hebrews 6:17
text: Wherein God, being minded to show more abundantly unto the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

title: Hebrews 6:18
text: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to lay hold of the hope set before us:

title: Hebrews 6:19
text: which we have as an anchor of the soul, [a hope] both sure and stedfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

title: Hebrews 6:20
text: whither as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

title: Hebrews 7:1
text: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

title: Hebrews 7:2
