text: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, King of righteousness, and then also King of Salem, which is King of peace;

title: Hebrews 7:3
text: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like unto the Son of God), abideth a priest continually.

title: Hebrews 7:4
text: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the chief spoils.

title: Hebrews 7:5
text: And they indeed of the sons of Levi that receive the priest's office have commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though these have come out of the loins of Abraham:

title: Hebrews 7:6
text: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them hath taken tithes of Abraham, and hath blessed him that hath the promises.

title: Hebrews 7:7
text: But without any dispute the less is blessed of the better.

title: Hebrews 7:8
text: And here men that die receive tithes; but there one, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

title: Hebrews 7:9
text: And, so to say, through Abraham even Levi, who receiveth tithes, hath paid tithes;

title: Hebrews 7:10
text: for he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchizedek met him.

title: Hebrews 7:11
text: Now if there was perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it hath the people received the law), what further need [was there] that another priest should arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be reckoned after the order of Aaron?

title: Hebrews 7:12
text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

title: Hebrews 7:13
text: For he of whom these things are said belongeth to another tribe, from which no man hath given attendance at the altar.

title: Hebrews 7:14
text: For it is evident that our Lord hath sprung out of Judah; as to which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priests.

title: Hebrews 7:15
text: And [what we say] is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there ariseth another priest,

title: Hebrews 7:16
text: who hath been made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

title: Hebrews 7:17
text: for it is witnessed [of him,] Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

title: Hebrews 7:18
text: For there is a disannulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and unprofitableness

title: Hebrews 7:19
text: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in thereupon of a better hope, through which we draw nigh unto God.

title: Hebrews 7:20
text: And inasmuch as [it is] not without the taking of an oath

title: Hebrews 7:21
text: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath; but he with an oath by him that saith of him, The Lord sware and will not repent himself, Thou art a priest for ever);

title: Hebrews 7:22
text: by so much also hath Jesus become the surety of a better covenant.

title: Hebrews 7:23
text: And they indeed have been made priests many in number, because that by death they are hindered from continuing:

title: Hebrews 7:24
text: but he, because he abideth for ever, hath his priesthood unchangeable.

title: Hebrews 7:25
text: Wherefore also he is able to save to the uttermost them that draw near unto God through him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

title: Hebrews 7:26
text: For such a high priest became us, holy, guileless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

title: Hebrews 7:27
text: who needeth not daily, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for his own sins, and then for the [sins] of the people: for this he did once for all, when he offered up himself.

title: Hebrews 7:28
text: For the law appointeth men high priests, having infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was after the law, [appointeth] a Son, perfected for evermore.

title: Hebrews 8:1
text: Now in the things which we are saying the chief point [is this]: We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

title: Hebrews 8:2
text: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

title: Hebrews 8:3
text: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is necessary that this [high priest] also have somewhat to offer.

title: Hebrews 8:4
text: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are those who offer the gifts according to the law;

title: Hebrews 8:5
text: who serve [that which is] a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses is warned [of God] when he is about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern that was showed thee in the mount.

title: Hebrews 8:6
text: But now hath he obtained a ministry the more excellent, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which hath been enacted upon better promises.

title: Hebrews 8:7
text: For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, then would no place have been sought for a second.

title: Hebrews 8:8
text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, That I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

title: Hebrews 8:9
text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers In the day that I took them by the hand to lead them forth out of the land of Egypt; For they continued not in my covenant, And I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

title: Hebrews 8:10
text: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel After those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, And on their heart also will I write them: And I will be to them a God, And they shall be to me a people:

title: Hebrews 8:11
text: And they shall not teach every man his fellow-citizen, And every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: For all shall know me, From the least to the greatest of them.

title: Hebrews 8:12
text: For I will be merciful to their iniquities, And their sins will I remember no more.

title: Hebrews 8:13
text: In that he saith, A new [covenant] he hath made the first old. But that which is becoming old and waxeth aged is nigh unto vanishing away.

title: Hebrews 9:1
text: Now even a first [covenant] had ordinances of divine service, and its sanctuary, [a sanctuary] of this world.

title: Hebrews 9:2
text: For there was a tabernacle prepared, the first, wherein [were] the candlestick, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the Holy place.

title: Hebrews 9:3
text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holy of holies;

title: Hebrews 9:4
text: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein [was] a golden pot holding the manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

title: Hebrews 9:5
text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy-seat; of which things we cannot now speak severally.

title: Hebrews 9:6
text: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services;

title: Hebrews 9:7
text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offereth for himself, and for the errors of the people:

title: Hebrews 9:8
text: the Holy Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holy place hath not yet been made manifest, while the first tabernacle is yet standing;

title: Hebrews 9:9
text: which [is] a figure for the time present; according to which are offered both gifts and sacrifices that cannot, as touching the conscience, make the worshipper perfect,

title: Hebrews 9:10
text: [being] only (with meats and drinks and divers washings) carnal ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

title: Hebrews 9:11
text: But Christ having come a high priest of the good things to come, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

title: Hebrews 9:12
text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption.

title: Hebrews 9:13
text: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling them that have been defiled, sanctify unto the cleanness of the flesh:

title: Hebrews 9:14
text: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish unto God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

title: Hebrews 9:15
text: And for this cause he is the mediator of a new covenant, that a death having taken place for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, they that have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

title: Hebrews 9:16
text: For where a testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him that made it.

title: Hebrews 9:17
text: For a testament is of force where there hath been death: for it doth never avail while he that made it liveth.

title: Hebrews 9:18
text: Wherefore even the first [covenant] hath not been dedicated without blood.

title: Hebrews 9:19
text: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses unto all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

title: Hebrews 9:20
text: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded to you-ward.

title: Hebrews 9:21
text: Moreover the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry he sprinkled in like manner with the blood.

title: Hebrews 9:22
text: And according to the law, I may almost say, all things are cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

title: Hebrews 9:23
text: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

title: Hebrews 9:24
text: For Christ entered not into a holy place made with hands, like in pattern to the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us:

title: Hebrews 9:25
text: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place year by year with blood not his own;

title: Hebrews 9:26
text: else must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once at the end of the ages hath he been manifested to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

title: Hebrews 9:27
text: And inasmuch as it is appointed unto men once to die, and after this [cometh] judgment;

title: Hebrews 9:28
text: so Christ also, having been once offered to bear the sins of many, shall appear a second time, apart from sin, to them that wait for him, unto salvation.

title: Hebrews 10:1
text: For the law having a shadow of the good [things] to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect them that draw nigh.

title: Hebrews 10:2
text: Else would they not have ceased to be offered? because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins.

title: Hebrews 10:3
text: But in those [sacrifices] there is a remembrance made of sins year by year.

title: Hebrews 10:4
text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

title: Hebrews 10:5
text: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, But a body didst thou prepare for me;

title: Hebrews 10:6
text: In whole burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin thou hadst no pleasure:

title: Hebrews 10:7
text: Then said I, Lo, I am come (In the roll of the book it is written of me) To do thy will, O God.

title: Hebrews 10:8
text: Saying above, Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein (the which are offered according to the law),

title: Hebrews 10:9
text: then hath he said, Lo, I am come to do thy will. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

title: Hebrews 10:10
text: By which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

title: Hebrews 10:11
text: And every priest indeed standeth day by day ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, the which can never take away sins:

title: Hebrews 10:12
text: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

title: Hebrews 10:13
text: henceforth expecting till his enemies be made the footstool of his feet.

title: Hebrews 10:14
text: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

title: Hebrews 10:15
text: And the Holy Spirit also beareth witness to us; for after he hath said,

title: Hebrews 10:16
text: This is the covenant that I will make with them After those days, saith the Lord: I will put my laws on their heart, And upon their mind also will I write them; [then saith he,]

title: Hebrews 10:17
text: And their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

title: Hebrews 10:18
text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

title: Hebrews 10:19
text: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

title: Hebrews 10:20
text: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

title: Hebrews 10:21
text: and [having] a great priest over the house of God;

title: Hebrews 10:22
text: let us draw near with a true heart in fulness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience: and having our body washed with pure water,

title: Hebrews 10:23
text: let us hold fast the confession of our hope that it waver not; for he is faithful that promised:

title: Hebrews 10:24
text: and let us consider one another to provoke unto love and good works;

title: Hebrews 10:25
text: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting [one another]; and so much the more, as ye see the day drawing nigh.

title: Hebrews 10:26
text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more a sacrifice for sins,

title: Hebrews 10:27
text: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which shall devour the adversaries.

title: Hebrews 10:28
text: A man that hath set at nought Moses law dieth without compassion on [the word of] two or three witnesses:

title: Hebrews 10:29
text: of how much sorer punishment, think ye, shall he be judged worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant wherewith he was sanctified an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

title: Hebrews 10:30
text: For we know him that said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

title: Hebrews 10:31
text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

title: Hebrews 10:32
text: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were enlightened, ye endured a great conflict of sufferings;

title: Hebrews 10:33
text: partly, being made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, becoming partakers with them that were so used.

title: Hebrews 10:34
text: For ye both had compassion on them that were in bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of you possessions, knowing that ye have for yourselves a better possession and an abiding one.

title: Hebrews 10:35
text: Cast not away therefore your boldness, which hath great recompense of reward.

title: Hebrews 10:36
text: For ye have need of patience, that, having done the will of God, ye may receive the promise.

title: Hebrews 10:37
text: For yet a very little while, He that cometh shall come, and shall not tarry.

title: Hebrews 10:38
text: But my righteous one shall live by faith: And if he shrink back, my soul hath no pleasure in him.

title: Hebrews 10:39
text: But we are not of them that shrink back unto perdition; but of them that have faith unto the saving of the soul.

title: Hebrews 11:1
text: Now faith is assurance of [things] hoped for, a conviction of things not seen.

title: Hebrews 11:2
text: For therein the elders had witness borne to them.

title: Hebrews 11:3
text: By faith we understand that the worlds have been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen hath not been made out of things which appear.

title: Hebrews 11:4
text: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had witness borne to him that he was righteous, God bearing witness in respect of his gifts: and through it he being dead yet speaketh.

title: Hebrews 11:5
text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and he was not found, because God translated him: for he hath had witness borne to him that before his translation he had been well-pleasing unto God:

title: Hebrews 11:6
text: And without faith it is impossible to be well-pleasing [unto him]; for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that seek after him.

title: Hebrews 11:7
text: By faith Noah, being warned [of God] concerning things not seen as yet, moved with godly fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

title: Hebrews 11:8
text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out unto a place which he was to receive for an inheritance; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

title: Hebrews 11:9
text: By faith he became a sojourner in the land of promise, as in a [land] not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

title: Hebrews 11:10
text: for he looked for the city which hath the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

title: Hebrews 11:11
text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive seed when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised:

title: Hebrews 11:12
text: wherefore also there sprang of one, and him as good as dead, [so many] as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the sand, which is by the sea-shore, innumerable.

title: Hebrews 11:13
text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:14
text: For they that say such things make it manifest that they are seeking after a country of their own.

title: Hebrews 11:15
text: And if indeed they had been mindful of that [country] from which they went out, they would have had opportunity to return.

title: Hebrews 11:16
text: But now they desire a better [country], that is, a heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God; for he hath prepared for them a city.

title: Hebrews 11:17
text: By faith Abraham, being tried, offered up Isaac: yea, he that had gladly received the promises was offering up his only begotten [son];

title: Hebrews 11:18
text: even he to whom it was said, In Isaac shall thy seed be called:

title: Hebrews 11:19
text: accounting that God [is] able to raise up, even from the dead; from whence he did also in a figure receive him back.

title: Hebrews 11:20
text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

title: Hebrews 11:21
text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, [leaning] upon the top of his staff.

title: Hebrews 11:22
text: By faith Joseph, when his end was nigh, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

title: Hebrews 11:23
text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw he was a goodly child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

title: Hebrews 11:24
text: By faith Moses, when he was grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

title: Hebrews 11:25
text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

title: Hebrews 11:26
text: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt: for he looked unto the recompense of reward.

title: Hebrews 11:27
text: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

title: Hebrews 11:28
text: By faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

title: Hebrews 11:29
text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were swallowed up.

title: Hebrews 11:30
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed about for seven days.

title: Hebrews 11:31
text: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with them that were disobedient, having received the spies with peace.

title: Hebrews 11:32
text: And what shall I more say? for the time will fail me if I tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah; of David and Samuel and the prophets:

title: Hebrews 11:33
text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

title: Hebrews 11:34
text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, waxed mighty in war, turned to flight armies of aliens.

title: Hebrews 11:35
text: Women received their dead by a resurrection: and others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

title: Hebrews 11:36
text: and others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

title: Hebrews 11:37
text: they were stoned, they were sawn asunder, they were tempted, they were slain with the sword: they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

title: Hebrews 11:38
text: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts and mountains and caves, and the holes of the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:39
text: And these all, having had witness borne to them through their faith, received not the promise,

title: Hebrews 11:40
text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

title: Hebrews 12:1
text: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

title: Hebrews 12:2
text: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of [our] faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

title: Hebrews 12:3
text: For consider him that hath endured such gainsaying of sinners against himself, that ye wax not weary, fainting in your souls.

title: Hebrews 12:4
text: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:

title: Hebrews 12:5
text: and ye have forgotten the exhortation which reasoneth with you as with sons, My son, regard not lightly the chastening of the Lord, Nor faint when thou art reproved of him;

title: Hebrews 12:6
text: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, And scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

title: Hebrews 12:7
text: It is for chastening that ye endure; God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is there whom [his] father chasteneth not?

title: Hebrews 12:8
text: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

title: Hebrews 12:9
text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

title: Hebrews 12:10
text: For they indeed for a few days chastened [us] as seemed good to them; but he for [our] profit, that [we] may be partakers of his holiness.

title: Hebrews 12:11
text: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, [even the fruit] of righteousness.

title: Hebrews 12:12
text: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;

title: Hebrews 12:13
text: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned out of the way, but rather be healed.

title: Hebrews 12:14
text: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man shall see the Lord:

title: Hebrews 12:15
text: looking carefully lest [there be] any man that falleth short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble [you], and thereby the many be defiled;

title: Hebrews 12:16
text: lest [there be] any fornication, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.

title: Hebrews 12:17
text: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind [in his father,] though he sought is diligently with tears.

title: Hebrews 12:18
text: For ye are not come unto [a mount] that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

title: Hebrews 12:19
text: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which [voice] they that heard entreated that no word more should be spoken unto them;

title: Hebrews 12:20
text: for they could not endure that which was enjoined, If even a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;

title: Hebrews 12:21
text: and so fearful was the appearance, [that] Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:

title: Hebrews 12:22
text: but ye are come unto mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable hosts of angels,

title: Hebrews 12:23
text: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

title: Hebrews 12:24
text: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better than [that of] Abel.

title: Hebrews 12:25
text: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not when they refused him that warned [them] on earth, much more [shall not] we [escape] who turn away from him that [warneth] from heaven:

title: Hebrews 12:26
text: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more will I make to tremble not the earth only, but also the heaven.

title: Hebrews 12:27
text: And this [word], Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

title: Hebrews 12:28
text: Wherefore, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, whereby we may offer service well-pleasing to God with reverence and awe:

title: Hebrews 12:29
text: for our God is a consuming fire.

title: Hebrews 13:1
text: Let love of the brethren continue.

title: Hebrews 13:2
text: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

title: Hebrews 13:3
text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are illtreated, as being yourselves also in the body.

title: Hebrews 13:4
text: [Let] marriage [be] had in honor among all, and [let] the bed [be] undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

title: Hebrews 13:5
text: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.

title: Hebrews 13:6
text: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?

title: Hebrews 13:7
text: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.

title: Hebrews 13:8
text: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday and to-day, [yea] and for ever.

title: Hebrews 13:9
text: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.

title: Hebrews 13:10
text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.

title: Hebrews 13:11
text: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest [as an offering] for sin, are burned without the camp.

title: Hebrews 13:12
text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.

title: Hebrews 13:13
text: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

title: Hebrews 13:14
text: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after [the city] which is to come.

title: Hebrews 13:15
text: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.

title: Hebrews 13:16
text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

title: Hebrews 13:17
text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit [to them]: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this [were] unprofitable for you.

title: Hebrews 13:18
text: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

title: Hebrews 13:19
text: And I exhort [you] the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

title: Hebrews 13:20
text: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, [even] our Lord Jesus,

title: Hebrews 13:21
text: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Hebrews 13:22
text: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have written unto you in few words.

title: Hebrews 13:23
text: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

title: Hebrews 13:24
text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

title: Hebrews 13:25
text: Grace be with you all. Amen.

title: James 1:1
text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are of the Dispersion, greeting.

title: James 1:2
text: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations;

title: James 1:3
text: Knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.

title: James 1:4
text: And let patience have [its] perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, lacking in nothing.

title: James 1:5
text: But if any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all liberally and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

title: James 1:6
text: But let him ask in faith, nothing doubting: for he that doubteth is like the surge of the sea driven by the wind and tossed.

title: James 1:7
text: For let not that man think that he shall receive anything of the Lord;

title: James 1:8
text: a doubleminded man, unstable in all his ways.

title: James 1:9
text: But let the brother of low degree glory in his high estate:

title: James 1:10
text: and the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

title: James 1:11
text: For the sun ariseth with the scorching wind, and withereth the grass: and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his goings.

title: James 1:12
text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been approved, he shall receive the crown of life, which [the Lord] promised to them that love him.

title: James 1:13
text: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God; for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempteth no man:

title: James 1:14
text: but each man is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

title: James 1:15
text: Then the lust, when it hath conceived, beareth sin: and the sin, when it is fullgrown, bringeth forth death.

title: James 1:16
text: Be not deceived, my beloved brethren.

title: James 1:17
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, neither shadow that is cast by turning.

title: James 1:18
text: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

title: James 1:19
text: Ye know [this], my beloved brethren. But let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

title: James 1:20
text: for the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

title: James 1:21
text: Wherefore putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

title: James 1:22
text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.

title: James 1:23
text: For if any one is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a mirror:

title: James 1:24
text: for he beholdeth himself, and goeth away, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

title: James 1:25
text: But he that looketh into the perfect law, the [law] of liberty, and [so] continueth, being not a hearer that forgetteth but a doer that worketh, this man shall be blessed in his doing.

title: James 1:26
text: If any man thinketh himself to be religious, while he bridleth not his tongue but deceiveth his heart, this man's religion is vain.

title: James 1:27
text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, [and] to keep oneself unspotted from the world.

title: James 2:1
text: My brethren, hold not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, [the Lord] of glory, with respect of persons.

title: James 2:2
text: For if there come into your synagogue a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, and there come in also a poor man in vile clothing;

title: James 2:3
text: and ye have regard to him that weareth the fine clothing, and say, Sit thou here in a good place; and ye say to the poor man, Stand thou there, or sit under my footstool;

title: James 2:4
text: Do ye not make distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

title: James 2:5
text: Hearken, my beloved brethren; did not God choose them that are poor as to the world [to be] rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he promised to them that love him?

title: James 2:6
text: But ye have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you, and themselves drag you before the judgment-seats?

title: James 2:7
text: Do not they blaspheme the honorable name by which ye are called?

title: James 2:8
text: Howbeit if ye fulfil the royal law, according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself, ye do well:

title: James 2:9
text: but if ye have respect of persons, ye commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

title: James 2:10
text: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one [point], he is become guilty of all.

title: James 2:11
text: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou dost not commit adultery, but killest, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

title: James 2:12
text: So speak ye, and so do, as men that are to be judged by a law of liberty.

title: James 2:13
text: For judgment [is] without mercy to him that hath showed no mercy: mercy glorieth against judgment.

title: James 2:14
text: What doth it profit, my brethren, if a man say he hath faith, but have not works? can that faith save him?

title: James 2:15
text: If a brother or sister be naked and in lack of daily food,

title: James 2:16
text: and one of you say unto them, Go in peace, be ye warmed and filled; and yet ye give them not the things needful to the body; what doth it profit?

title: James 2:17
text: Even so faith, if it have not works, is dead in itself.

title: James 2:18
text: Yea, a man will say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: show me thy faith apart from [thy] works, and I by my works will show thee [my] faith.

title: James 2:19
text: Thou believest that God is one; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and shudder.

title: James 2:20
text: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith apart from works is barren?

title: James 2:21
text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son upon the altar?

title: James 2:22
text: Thou seest that faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect;

title: James 2:23
text: and the scripture was fulfilled which saith, And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness; and he was called the friend of God.

title: James 2:24
text: Ye see that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

title: James 2:25
text: And in like manner was not also Rahab the harlot justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

title: James 2:26
text: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

title: James 3:1
text: Be not many [of you] teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive heavier judgment.

title: James 3:2
text: For in many things we all stumble. If any stumbleth not in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

title: James 3:3
text: Now if we put the horses' bridles into their mouths that they may obey us, we turn about their whole body also.

title: James 3:4
text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so great and are driven by rough winds, are yet turned about by a very small rudder, whither the impulse of the steersman willeth.

title: James 3:5
text: So the tongue also is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how much wood is kindled by how small a fire!

title: James 3:6
text: And the tongue is a fire: the world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the wheel of nature, and is set on fire by hell.

title: James 3:7
text: For every kind of beasts and birds, of creeping things and things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed by mankind.

title: James 3:8
text: But the tongue can no man tame; [it is] a restless evil, [it is] full of deadly poison.

title: James 3:9
text: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father; and therewith curse we men, who are made after the likeness of God:

title: James 3:10
text: out of the same mouth cometh forth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

title: James 3:11
text: Doth the fountain send forth from the same opening sweet [water] and bitter?

title: James 3:12
text: Can a fig tree, my brethren, yield olives, or a vine figs? Neither [can] salt water yield sweet.

title: James 3:13
text: Who is wise and understanding among you? let him show by his good life his works in meekness of wisdom.

title: James 3:14
text: But if ye have bitter jealousy and faction in your heart, glory not and lie not against the truth.

title: James 3:15
text: This wisdom is not [a wisdom] that cometh down from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

title: James 3:16
text: For where jealousy and faction are, there is confusion and every vile deed.

title: James 3:17
text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without variance, without hypocrisy.

title: James 3:18
text: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace for them that make peace.

title: James 4:1
text: Whence [come] wars and whence [come] fightings among you? [come they] not hence, [even] of your pleasures that war in your members?

title: James 4:2
text: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and covet, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war; ye have not, because ye ask not.

title: James 4:3
text: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may spend [it] in your pleasures.

title: James 4:4
text: Ye adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Whosoever therefore would be a friend of the world maketh himself an enemy of God.

title: James 4:5
text: Or think ye that the scripture speaketh in vain? Doth the spirit which he made to dwell in us long unto envying?

title: James 4:6
text: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore [the scripture] saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

title: James 4:7
text: Be subject therefore unto God; but resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

title: James 4:8
text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.

title: James 4:9
text: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

title: James 4:10
text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.

title: James 4:11
text: Speak not one against another, brethren. He that speaketh against a brother, or judgeth his brother, speaketh against the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judgest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

title: James 4:12
text: One [only] is the lawgiver and judge, [even] he who is able to save and to destroy: but who art thou that judgest thy neighbor?

title: James 4:13
text: Come now, ye that say, To-day or to-morrow we will go into this city, and spend a year there, and trade, and get gain:

title: James 4:14
text: whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. What is your life? For ye are a vapor, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

title: James 4:15
text: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall both live, and do this or that.

title: James 4:16
text: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.

title: James 4:17
text: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

title: James 5:1
text: Come now, ye rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon you.

title: James 5:2
text: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.

title: James 5:3
text: Your gold and your silver are rusted; and their rust shall be for a testimony against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have laid up your treasure in the last days.

title: James 5:4
text: Behold, the hire of the laborers who mowed your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth out: and the cries of them that reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.

title: James 5:5
text: Ye have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure; ye have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.

title: James 5:6
text: Ye have condemned, ye have killed the righteous [one]; he doth not resist you.

title: James 5:7
text: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receive the early and latter rain.

title: James 5:8
text: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

title: James 5:9
text: Murmur not, brethren, one against another, that ye be not judged: behold, the judge standeth before the doors.

title: James 5:10
text: Take, brethren, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spake in the name of the Lord.

title: James 5:11
text: Behold, we call them blessed that endured: ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord, how that the Lord is full of pity, and merciful.

title: James 5:12
text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by the heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath: but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay; that ye fall not under judgment.

title: James 5:13
text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praise.

title: James 5:14
text: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

title: James 5:15
text: and the prayer of faith shall save him that is sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.

title: James 5:16
text: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.

title: James 5:17
text: Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain; and it rained not on the earth for three years and six months.

title: James 5:18
text: And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

title: James 5:19
text: My brethren, if any among you err from the truth, and one convert him;

title: James 5:20
text: let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 1:1
text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

title: I Peter 1:2
text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

title: I Peter 1:3
text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

title: I Peter 1:4
text: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

title: I Peter 1:5
text: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

title: I Peter 1:6
text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,

title: I Peter 1:7
text: that the proof of your faith, [being] more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

title: I Peter 1:8
text: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

title: I Peter 1:9
text: receiving the end of your faith, [even] the salvation of [your] souls.

title: I Peter 1:10
text: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that [should come] unto you:

title: I Peter 1:11
text: searching what [time] or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.

title: I Peter 1:12
text: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angel desire to look into.

title: I Peter 1:13
text: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

title: I Peter 1:14
text: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in [the time of] your ignorance:

title: I Peter 1:15
text: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;

title: I Peter 1:16
text: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.

title: I Peter 1:17
text: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man's work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:

title: I Peter 1:18
text: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;

title: I Peter 1:19
text: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without spot, [even the blood] of Christ:

title: I Peter 1:20
text: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of times for your sake,

title: I Peter 1:21
text: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

title: I Peter 1:22
text: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:

title: I Peter 1:23
text: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.

title: I Peter 1:24
text: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:

title: I Peter 1:25
text: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.

title: I Peter 2:1
text: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

title: I Peter 2:2
text: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;

title: I Peter 2:3
text: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

title: I Peter 2:4
text: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,

title: I Peter 2:5
text: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 2:6
text: Because it is contained in scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.

title: I Peter 2:7
text: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;

title: I Peter 2:8
text: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

title: I Peter 2:9
text: But ye are a elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for [God's] own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

title: I Peter 2:10
text: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

title: I Peter 2:11
text: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lust, which war against the soul;

title: I Peter 2:12
text: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

title: I Peter 2:13
text: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

title: I Peter 2:14
text: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.

title: I Peter 2:15
text: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

title: I Peter 2:16
text: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

title: I Peter 2:17
text: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

title: I Peter 2:18
text: Servants, [be] in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

title: I Peter 2:19
text: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.

title: I Peter 2:20
text: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted [for it], ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer [for it], ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

title: I Peter 2:21
text: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:

title: I Peter 2:22
text: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

title: I Peter 2:23
text: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered threatened not; but committed [himself] to him that judgeth righteously:

title: I Peter 2:24
text: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.

title: I Peter 2:25
text: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

title: I Peter 3:1
text: In like manner, ye wives, [be] in subjection to your won husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;

title: I Peter 3:2
text: beholding your chaste behavior [coupled] with fear.

title: I Peter 3:3
text: Whose [adorning] let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;

title: I Peter 3:4
text: but [let it be] the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible [apparel] of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

title: I Peter 3:5
text: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

title: I Peter 3:6
text: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

title: I Peter 3:7
text: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with [your wives] according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.

title: I Peter 3:8
text: Finally, [be] ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:

title: I Peter 3:9
text: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

title: I Peter 3:10
text: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:

title: I Peter 3:11
text: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

title: I Peter 3:12
text: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.

title: I Peter 3:13
text: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?

title: I Peter 3:14
text: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness' sake, blessed [are ye:] and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;

title: I Peter 3:15
text: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: [being] ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:

title: I Peter 3:16
text: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.

title: I Peter 3:17
text: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.

title: I Peter 3:18
text: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

title: I Peter 3:19
text: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,

title: I Peter 3:20
text: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:

title: I Peter 3:21
text: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, [even] baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;

title: I Peter 3:22
text: who is one the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

title: I Peter 4:2
text: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:

title: I Peter 4:4
text: wherein they think strange that ye run not with [them] into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of [of]:

title: I Peter 4:5
text: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:

title: I Peter 4:8
text: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:

title: I Peter 4:9
text: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:

title: I Peter 4:10
text: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;

title: I Peter 4:11
text: if any man speaketh, [speaking] as it were oracles of God; is any man ministereth, [ministering] as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:

title: I Peter 4:13
text: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed [are ye]; because the [Spirit] of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.

title: I Peter 4:15
text: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men's matters:

title: I Peter 4:16
text: but if [a man suffer] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: For the time [is come] for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if [it begin] first at us, what [shall be] the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?

title: I Peter 4:19
text: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: The elders among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

title: I Peter 5:2
text: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to [the will of] God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

title: I Peter 5:3
text: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.

title: I Peter 5:4
text: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

title: I Peter 5:6
text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

title: I Peter 5:7
text: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour,

title: I Peter 5:9
text: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.

title: I Peter 5:11
text: To him [be] the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account [him], I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand ye fast therein.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: She that is in Babylon, elect together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Mark my son.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and [the] Saviour Jesus Christ:

title: II Peter 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;

title: II Peter 1:3
text: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;

title: II Peter 1:4
text: whereby he hath granted unto us his precious and exceeding great promises; that through these ye may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in that world by lust.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: Yea, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply virtue; and in [your] virtue knowledge;

title: II Peter 1:6
text: and in [your] knowledge self-control; and in [your] self-control patience; and in [your] patience godliness;

title: II Peter 1:7
text: and in [your] godliness brotherly kindness; and in [your] brotherly kindness love.

title: II Peter 1:8
text: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful unto the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:9
text: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

title: II Peter 1:10
text: Wherefore, brethren, give the more diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never stumble:

title: II Peter 1:11
text: for thus shall be richly supplied unto you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: Wherefore I shall be ready always to put you in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and are established in the truth which is with [you].

title: II Peter 1:13
text: And I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

title: II Peter 1:14
text: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.

title: II Peter 1:15
text: Yea, I will give diligence that at every time ye may be able after my decease to call these things to remembrance.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:

title: II Peter 1:18
text: and this voice we [ourselves] heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: And we have the word of prophecy [made] more sure; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts:

title: II Peter 1:20
text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.

title: II Peter 1:21
text: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spake from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

title: II Peter 2:1
text: But there arose false prophets also among the people, as among you also there shall be false teachers, who shall privily bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.

title: II Peter 2:2
text: And many shall follow their lascivious doings; by reason of whom the way of the truth shall be evil spoken of.

title: II Peter 2:3
text: And in covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose sentence now from of old lingereth not, and their destruction slumbereth not.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: For if God spared not angels when they sinned, but cast them down to hell, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

title: II Peter 2:5
text: and spared not the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:6
text: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, having made them an example unto those that should live ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:7
text: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked

title: II Peter 2:8
text: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] lawless deeds):

title: II Peter 2:9
text: the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment unto the day of judgment;

title: II Peter 2:10
text: but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise dominion. Daring, self-willed, they tremble not to rail at dignities:

title: II Peter 2:11
text: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

title: II Peter 2:12
text: But these, as creatures without reason, born mere animals to be taken and destroyed, railing in matters whereof they are ignorant, shall in their destroying surely be destroyed,

title: II Peter 2:13
text: suffering wrong as the hire of wrong-doing; [men] that count it pleasure to revel in the day-time, spots and blemishes, revelling in their deceivings while they feast with you;

title: II Peter 2:14
text: having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; enticing unstedfast souls; having a heart exercised in covetousness; children of cursing;

title: II Peter 2:15
text: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the [son] of Beor, who loved the hire of wrong-doing;

title: II Peter 2:16
text: but he was rebuked for his own transgression: a dumb ass spake with man's voice and stayed the madness of the prophet.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: These are springs without water, and mists driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved.

title: II Peter 2:18
text: For, uttering great swelling [words] of vanity, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by lasciviousness, those who are just escaping from them that live in error;

title: II Peter 2:19
text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he also brought into bondage.

title: II Peter 2:20
text: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein and overcome, the last state is become worse with them than the first.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: For it were better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: It has happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog turning to his own vomit again, and the sow that had washed to wallowing in the mire.

title: II Peter 3:1
text: This is now, beloved, the second epistle that I write unto you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by putting you in remembrance;

title: II Peter 3:2
text: that ye should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandments of the Lord and Saviour through your apostles:

title: II Peter 3:3
text: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers shall come with mockery, walking after their own lusts,

title: II Peter 3:4
text: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth compacted out of water and amidst water, by the word of God;

title: II Peter 3:6
text: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

title: II Peter 3:7
text: but the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: But forget not this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: Seeing that these things are thus all to be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in [all] holy living and godliness,

title: II Peter 3:12
text: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, by reason of which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

title: II Peter 3:13
text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for these things, give diligence that ye may be found in peace, without spot and blameless in his sight.

title: II Peter 3:15
text: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote unto you;

title: II Peter 3:16
text: as also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; wherein are some things hard to be understood, which the ignorant and unstedfast wrest, as [they do] also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

title: II Peter 3:17
text: Ye therefore, beloved, knowing [these things] beforehand, beware lest, being carried away with the error of the wicked, ye fall from your own stedfastness.

title: II Peter 3:18
text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] the glory both now and for ever. Amen.

title: I John 1:1
text: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life

title: I John 1:2
text: (and the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare unto you the life, the eternal [life], which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us);

title: I John 1:3
text: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you also, that ye also may have fellowship with us: yea, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ:

title: I John 1:4
text: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.

title: I John 1:5
text: And this is the message which we have heard from him and announce unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

title: I John 1:7
text: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

title: I John 2:2
text: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

title: I John 2:3
text: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

title: I John 2:4
text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;

title: I John 2:5
text: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:

title: I John 2:6
text: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.

title: I John 2:7
text: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.

title: I John 2:8
text: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.

title: I John 2:9
text: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

title: I John 2:10
text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.

title: I John 2:11
text: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.

title: I John 2:12
text: I write unto you, [my] little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.

title: I John 2:15
text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

title: I John 2:16
text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vain glory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

title: I John 2:17
text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

title: I John 2:18
text: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.

title: I John 2:19
text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but [they went out], that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.

title: I John 2:20
text: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all the things.

title: I John 2:21
text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, [even] he that denieth the Father and the Son.

title: I John 2:23
text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.

title: I John 2:24
text: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is the promise which he promised us, [even] the life eternal.

title: I John 2:26
text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.

title: I John 2:27
text: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you; concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.

title: I John 2:28
text: And now, [my] little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.

title: I John 3:1
text: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and [such] we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

title: I John 3:2
text: Beloved, now are we children of God, and it is not yet made manifest what we shall be. We know that, if he shall be manifested, we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And every one that hath this hope [set] on him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
